jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN br. 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 22/26) i Odluke Upravnog vijeća, Dječji vrtić Cvrčak objavljuje: NATJEČAJ za zasnivanje radnoga odnosa na temelju ugovora o radu na neodređeno vrijeme, puno radno vrijeme, na radnome mjestu: ODGOJITELJ/ICA 1 izvršitelj Uvjeti za radno mjesto su: prema Zakonu o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN br. 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 22/26) i Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (NN br. 145/24, 62/25). 1. Studij: Rani i predškolski odgoj i obrazovanje o sveučilišni prijediplomski studij o stručni prijediplomski studij o studij kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s prijašnjim propisima o sveučilišni diplomski studij o stručni diplomski studij 2. Učiteljski studij, i to: sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij, stručni diplomski studij ili četverogodišnji stručni studij primarnoga obrazovanja i da je osoba završila program za stjecanje odgojno-obrazovnih kompetencija za rad s djecom rane i predškolske dobi, pod uvjetom da se na natječaj ne javi osoba koja ispunjava uvjete iz točke 1. 3. Učiteljski studij, i to: sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij ili četverogodišnji stručni studij primarnoga obrazovanja, uz uvjet da u roku od dvije godine od dana zasnivanja radnoga odnosa osoba završi program za stjecanje odgojno-obrazovnih kompetencija za rad s djecom rane i predškolske dobi, pod uvjetom da se na natječaj ne javi osoba koja ispunjava uvjete iz točke 1. i 2. Uz prijavu na natječaj kandidati/kinje dužni/e su priložiti: 1. životopis 2. dokaz o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja 3. dokaz o državljanstvu 4. elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu HZMO (izdan u vrijeme trajanja ovog natječaja) 5. uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak prema čl. 25. st. 2. (izdano u vrijeme trajanja ovog natječaja) 6. uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak prema čl. 25. st. 4. (izdano u vrijeme trajanja ovog natječaja) 7. uvjerenje nadležnog ureda Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da osobi nije izrečena mjera prema čl. 25. st. 10. (izdano u vrijeme trajanja ovog natječaja) Radni odnos ne može zasnovati osoba za koju postoje zapreke za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici, a kandidat/kinja koji/a bude izabran/a dužan/na je predočiti izvornik. Kandidat/kinja koji/a ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu, dužan/na je u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te ima pravo prednosti u odnosu na ostale kandidate/kinje samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja može ostvariti pravo prednosti: -sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (,,Narodne novine“, broj: 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapošljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf -sukladno članku 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (,,Narodne novine“, broj: 84/21.), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapošljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf -sukladno članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (,,Narodne novine“, broj: 33/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca; - sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (,,Narodne novine“, broj: 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta priložiti i dokaz o invaliditetu te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca. Rok za podnošenje prijava na natječaj je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine te Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti osobnih podataka (NN br. 42/18.) prijavom na natječaj smatra se da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, a koja će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka i zapošljavanja. Plaća se sastoji od osnovne plaće, dodataka te ostalih primitaka u skladu sa Zakonom o radu (NN br. 93/14, 127/17, 98/19, 151/22, 46/23, 64/23.) i Kolektivnim ugovorom za zaposlene u predškolskim ustanovama Grada Zagreba (Službeni glasnik Grada Zagreba 40/22, 14/23, 15/23, 1/24, 26/24, 40/24. - ispravak, 41/24, 2/25, 13/25, 44/25, 6/26). Osnovna bruto plaća radnika za puno radno vrijeme predstavlja umnožak osnovice za izračun plaće i koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta na kojem radnik radi, uvećan za iznos dodatka na radni staž. Osnovica za obračun plaće iznosi 1.075,94 eura bruto. Koeficijent za obračun plaće utvrđen je Kolektivnim ugovorom te iznosi 2,10 (završen odgovarajući prijediplomski studij) i 2,14 (završen odgovarajući diplomski studij). Nepravovremene i/ili nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati. Sukladno članku 13. stavak 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN br. 82/08, 69/17), na natječaj se mogu javiti kandidati oba spola. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o odabiru na mrežnoj stranici Dječjeg vrtića Cvrčak. Prijave se podnose neposredno u tajništvo ili poštom na adresu: Turopoljska 29, 10000 Zagreb Obavezno naznačiti na prijavi „Za natječaj – odgojitelj na neodređeno vrijeme“.

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ODGOJITELJICA PREDŠKOLSKE DJECE
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 22/26), članka 48. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića Karlovac i odluke Upravnog vijeća od 24.08.2026.g., Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića Karlovac raspisuje NATJEČAJ za prijem u radni odnos - odgojitelj/ica predškolske djece - 1 izvršitelj za rad na određeno puno radno vrijeme – zamjena za porodiljni Kandidati moraju ispunjavati uvjete prema članku 24., 25. i 28. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 22/26) i odredbi Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (NN 145/24):
  • završen preddiplomski sveučilišni studij ili preddiplomski stručni studij za rad na radnom mjestu odgojitelja, odnosno studij za odgojitelja kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s ranijim propisima, ilizavršen diplomski sveučilišni studij ili specijalistički diplomski stručni studij za rad na radnom mjestu odgojitelja.
  • utvrđenu zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova (Vrtić će uputiti izabranog kandidata na utvrđivanje zdravstvene sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta). Radni odnos u dječjem vrtiću ne može zasnovati osoba koja ima zapreke iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju. Kandidati su obvezni dostaviti sljedeću dokumentaciju:
    1. pisanu zamolbu, vlastoručno potpisanu, s navodom na koji natječaj se kandidat javlja,
    2. životopis
    3. dokaz o stručnoj spremi,
    4. dokaz o državljanstvu,
    5. dokaz o radnom stažu: elektronički zapis ilipotvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a (e-radna knjižica) – ne starije od dana objave natječaja,
    6. dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (ne starije od dana objave natječaja): a) potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (čl. 25.st.2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju), i b) potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak (čl. 25.st.4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju).
Dokumentacija se predaje u neovjerenom presliku. Potvrdu da osoba nije pravomoćno osuđena za neko od kaznenih djela (čl.25.st1. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju) i/ili za neko od prekršajnih djela (čl.25.st.3. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju) pribavit će Vrtić po službenoj dužnosti od Ministarstva pravosuđa, uprave i digitalne transformacije, a nakon obavljenog izbora kandidata. Potvrdu da osobi nisu izrečene mjere za zaštitu dobrobiti djeteta sukladno posebnom propisu (čl.25.st10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju) pribavit će Vrtić po službenoj dužnosti od Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad, a nakon obavljenog izbora kandidata. Ako kandidat ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvat se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju dužan je uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju odnosno sve dokaze o ostvarenju prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu, rješenje ili potvrda o priznatom statusu iz kojeg je vidljivo navedeno pravo, potvrde o nezaposlenosti Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje izdanu u vrijeme trajanja natječaja te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod prethodnog poslodavca (rješenje, odluka, obavijest i sl.). Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) te članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi kandidat ostvario prednost pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 102. stavak 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23) dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj dostaviti dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti iz članka 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23). Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843, a dodatne informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni u svrhu ostvarivanje prednosti pri zapošljavanju, potražiti na slijedećoj poveznici: popis dokaza za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju- ZOHBDR 2021.pdf (gov.hr) Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 48. stavak 1.-2. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) koji u trenutku prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843, a dodatne informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni u svrhu ostvarivanje prednosti pri zapošljavanju, potražiti na slijedećoj poveznici: popis dokaza za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju- Zakon o civilnim stradalnicima iz DR.pdf (gov.hr) Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Dokaz o invaliditetu smatra se javna isprava na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom iz članka 13. navedenog Zakona. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su izričito suglasni da Dječji vrtić Karlovac može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine 42/18). Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2018. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnog kretanja takvih podatka, svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka. Zamolbu za prijem u radni odnos s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta dostaviti u roku od 8 (osam) dana od dana objave natječaja, odnosno zaključno s danom 02.09.2026.g. Zamolbu s dokazima je moguće dostaviti neposredno na urudžbeni zapisnik u tajništvo ustanove radnim danom od 8.00 do 14.00 sati ili poštom na adresu Dječji vrtić Karlovac, Tkalčeva 2, 47000 Karlovac, s naznakom: ˝Za natječaj za izbor odgojitelja – zamjena za porodiljni, ne otvarati ˝. Urednom prijavom na natječaj smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u tekstu ovog natječaja, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski spol. S kandidatima koji zadovoljavaju formalne uvijete natječaja provesti će se razgovor (intervju) i/ili testiranje. Obavijest o rezultatima natječaja objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici vrtića www.vrtic-karlovac.hr s navodom imena i prezimena izabranih kandidata. Dostavljena dokumentacija se neće vraćati kandidatima. Dječji vrtić Karlovac zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja odnosno pravo ne odabrati niti jednog kandidata, bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Dječjeg vrtića Karlovac dana 25.08.2026.g.

Statuta Dječjeg vrtića Luščić i odluke Upravnog vijeća od 21.8.2026. godine, Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića Luščić raspisuje NATJEČAJ za popunu radnog mjesta odgojitelj/ica predškolske djece m/ž - 1 izvršitelj/ica za rad na određeno puno radno vrijeme (za pripravnički staž) Kandidati moraju ispunjavati uvjete prema članku 24. i 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26) i prema članku 2. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno – obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog obrazovanja (Narodne novine broj 145/2024):
  • završen preddiplomski sveučilišni studij ili preddiplomski stručni studij za rad na radnom mjestu odgojitelja, odnosno studij za odgojitelja kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s ranijim propisima, ili završen diplomski sveučilišni studij ili specijalistički diplomski stručni studij za rad na radnom mjestu odgojitelja.
  • utvrđenu zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova (Vrtić će uputiti izabranog kandidata na utvrđivanje zdravstvene sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta). Radni odnos u dječjem vrtiću ne može zasnovati osoba koja ima zapreke iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju. Kandidati su obvezni dostaviti sljedeću dokumentaciju:
    • pisanu zamolbu, vlastoručno potpisanu, s navodom na koji natječaj se kandidat javlja,
    • životopis
    • dokaz o stručnoj spremi,
    • dokaz o državljanstvu ,
    • dokaz o radnom stažu: elektronički zapis ilipotvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a (e-radna knjižica- ne starije od dana objave natječaja),
    • dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju), i, b) potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak (čl. 25.st.4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju).

Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju) i/ili za neko od prekršajnih djela (čl.25.st.3. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju) pribavit će Vrtić po službenoj dužnosti od Ministarstva pravosuđa, a nakon obavljenog izbora kandidata. Potvrdu da osobi nisu izrečene mjere za zaštitu dobrobiti djeteta sukladno posebnom propisu (čl.25.st. 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju) pribavit će Vrtić po službenoj dužnosti od Centra za socijalnu skrb, a nakon obavljenog izbora kandidata. Ako kandidat ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju dužan je uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju odnosno sve dokaze o ostvarenju prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu, rješenje ili potvrda o priznatom statusu iz kojeg je vidljivo navedeno pravo, potvrde o nezaposlenosti Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje izdanu u vrijeme trajanja natječaja te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod prethodnog poslodavca (rješenje, odluka, obavijest i sl.). Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21, 13/26) te članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi kandidat ostvario prednost pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 102. stavak 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23) dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj dostaviti dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti iz članka 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23). Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapošljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 48. stavak 1.-2. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21, 13/26) koji u trenutku prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Dokaz o invaliditetu smatra se javna isprava na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom iz članka 13. navedenog Zakona. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su izričito suglasni da Dječji vrtić Luščić može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine 42/18). Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2018. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnog kretanja takvih podatka, svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka. Zamolbu za prijem u radni odnos s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta dostaviti u roku osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja, odnosno do 1.9.2026. godine. Zamolbu s dokazima je moguće dostaviti u zatvorenoj omotnici isključivo preporučenom poštom na adresu Dječji vrtić Luščić, Karlovac, Luščić 25 s naznakom: ˝Za natječaj za izbor odgojitelja –1 izvršitelj/ica za rad na određeno puno radno vrijeme (za pripravnički staž)– ne otvarati ˝. Urednom prijavom na natječaj smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u tekstu ovog natječaja, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski spol. Obavijest o rezultatima natječaja objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici vrtića www.vrtic-luscic.hr s navodom imena i prezimena izabranih kandidata. Dječji vrtić Luščić zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja odnosno pravo ne odabrati niti jednog kandidata, bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima. Dječji vrtić Luščić Upravno vijeće Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Dječjeg vrtića Luščić dana 25.8.2026. godine.

jobs.title: Italian Social Media Content Moderator (m,f) (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description:
Start: 03.08. or 10.08.26

We are working with a leading Outsourcing/BPO consultancy to recruit Italian-speaking Content Moderators for an on-site TikTok project in Lisbon.

In this role, you will ensure that content posted by users meets community guidelines and policies. You will work in a fast-paced, international environment, reviewing videos, posts, and comments, and helping to maintain a safe and positive online experience for users worldwide.

Your Role
Review and moderate user-generated content in Italian, including videos, posts, and comments
Identify and escalate inappropriate, harmful, or sensitive content
Apply professional judgment and ensure consistent moderation decisions
Collaborate with team members to resolve complex cases and identify recurring trends
Document moderation actions and maintain accurate records
Contribute to process improvements and knowledge sharing within the moderation team

Your Qualifications
Native or fluent Italian (C1/C2)
Good command of English (B2) for internal communication
Strong attention to detail and analytical skills
Comfortable handling sensitive content professionally and consistently
Previous experience in content moderation, social media, or customer support is a plus
Ability to work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment
Empathetic, professional, and resilient under pressure
Team player with a proactive and adaptable attitude

The Offer
Full-time, on-site position in Lisbon
Flights to Lisbon covered
Option to live in one of Teleperformance’s fully equipped, shared apartments, located 20–60 minutes from the workplace
Guidance and support throughout the relocation process
Paid professional training and structured onboarding
Health insurance and meal allowances from day one
Career growth and development opportunities in an international, multicultural environment

jobs.title: Social Media Content Moderator (m,f): Finnish,  Japonese, Spanish  or French (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description:
Start: monthly

We are working with a leading Outsourcing/BPO consultancy to recruit  Content Moderators for an on-site TikTok project in Lisbon.

In this role, you will ensure that content posted by users meets community guidelines and policies. You will work in a fast-paced, international environment, reviewing videos, posts, and comments, and helping to maintain a safe and positive online experience for users worldwide.

Your Role
Review and moderate user-generated content in Italian, including videos, posts, and comments
Identify and escalate inappropriate, harmful, or sensitive content
Apply professional judgment and ensure consistent moderation decisions
Collaborate with team members to resolve complex cases and identify recurring trends
Document moderation actions and maintain accurate records
Contribute to process improvements and knowledge sharing within the moderation team

Your Qualifications
Native or fluent Finnish or Japanese or Spanish or French C1/C2)
Good command of English (B2) for internal communication
Strong attention to detail and analytical skills
Comfortable handling sensitive content professionally and consistently
Previous experience in content moderation, social media, or customer support is a plus
Ability to work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment
Empathetic, professional, and resilient under pressure
Team player with a proactive and adaptable attitude

The Offer
Full-time, on-site position in Lisbon
Flights to Lisbon covered
Option to live in one of Teleperformance’s fully equipped, shared apartments, located 20–60 minutes from the workplace
Guidance and support throughout the relocation process
Paid professional training and structured onboarding
Health insurance and meal allowances from day one
Career growth and development opportunities in an international, multicultural environment

jobs.title: Senior System Architecture Engineer (m/f/d) - France (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Desay SV Automotive Europe GmbH, the European headquarters of Desay SV Automotive, is located in Weimar, Germany. As a technology specialist for advanced hardware, software, and connectivity, we play a key role in transferring Desay SV’s global innovation strength into tailored solutions for the European automotive market. Our corporate culture is characterized by dynamism, diversity, openness and fairness.

Desay SV Europe is part of Huizhou Desay SV Automotive Co., Ltd. based in China, a leading, stock exchange-listed provider of mobility solutions in the fields of Smart Cabin, Smart Drive and Smart Service. As a top 100 supplier and with its high level of technology expertise, Desay SV supports car manufacturers worldwide in their mobility transformation, making driving safer, more comfortable and more efficient.

We are looking for Senior System Architecture Engineer (m/f/d) in France

Your tasks

- As the onsite technical interface to customers, system architecture engineer shall lead technical proposal of project quotation, including requirement analysis and system design proposal.
- Responsible for system solution proposal, including:
1. Study RFI/RFQ documents from customer, analyze and clarify customer's requirement,
2. Leading/support System Concept Design proposal, coordinate R&D and output complete system solutions
3. Onsite TA (Technical Addendum) presentation and concern clarification,
4. Follow up questions raised by customers on technology assessment, and provide quick and professional service to customers, support them for the feasibility evaluation.
- Responsible for the product technology planning of strategic customers
- Act as an on-site technical window to customer for development project to support technical feasibility evaluation and explanation.

Your profile

- Many years of experience as system engineer in the automotive industry, ideally in the supplier industry in Europe,
- Well experienced of providing technical solution during quotation phase.
- Knowledge of the cockpit or ADAS domain controller
- Familiarity with current trends and technologies in the field of smart cockpit and autonomous driving
- Ability to analyze, summarize, coordinate and organize, define and refinerequirements.
- Ability to work in a team and collaborate effectively with stakeholders.
- Customer and solution-oriented thinking
- Excellent communication skills in English (is a must) and German (is a plus), Exceptional presentation and written skills (PowerPoint)
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in systems engineering, electrical engineering, computer science or a related field
- Energetic, passionate, curiousness, open-minded, resilient, and self-drive
- Willingness to travel (1-2 times per month)

We offer

- Training and continuing education
- Individual training
- Company cell phone
- Company laptop
- 30 Vacation days per year
- Company car
- Parking lot
- Flexible working hours
- Mobile working
- Good traffic connections
- Employee bonuses
- Employee events
- Friendly and trustful colleagues
- Accident insurance (private and professional)

We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant Manager  (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
jobs.description:
Senior Accountant Manager

Opis firmy

Ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach, które imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast, a wszystko to w atrakcyjnej cenie. Jako założyciel i prekursor koncepcji budget design, z sukcesem rozwijamy się w metropoliach Europy i poza nią.

Opis oferty pracy

- Prowadzenie i nadzór nad księgowością operacyjną hoteli w Polsce zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami oraz wytycznymi Centrali;
- Uzgadnianie rejestru VAT zakupu i sprzedaży;
- Raportowanie wyników finansowych dla hoteli w Gdańsku i Warszawie do Centrali, w tym analiza odchyleń oraz rekomendowanie działań korygujących.
- Ścisła współpraca z działem Controllingu, audytorami i pozostałymi działami hotelowymi w zakresie zagadnień finansowych, w tym obsługi procesów KSeF.
- Przygotowywanie przelewów do płatności, księgowanie wyciągów, rozliczanie kart kredytowych
- Przygotowywanie tygodniowych, miesięcznych i rocznych raportów finansowych zgodnie z wymaganiami działu kontroli finansowej.
- Czynny udział w procesach zamknięcia miesiąca, obejmujący uzgadnianie kont, kontrolę kosztów, inwentaryzację oraz weryfikację danych operacyjnych hoteli.
- Zapewnienie terminowego przygotowania dokumentacji do składania deklaracji podatkowych oraz zgodności z przepisami prawa podatkowego.
- Wsparcie w bieżących analizach finansowych oraz projektach związanych z optymalizacją kosztów i efektywnością operacyjną hoteli.
- Dbanie o prawidłowy obieg dokumentów w firmie oraz weryfikacja prawidłowości dokumentów księgowych

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

- Wyższe wykształcenie ekonomiczne;
- Min. 4 lata doświadczenia w dziale kontrolingu, mile widziane w branży hotelarskiej;
- Praktyczna, zaawansowana znajomość pakietu MS Office (w szczególności Excel);
- Znajomość języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego - warunek konieczny;
- Znajomość specyfiki finansów hotelowych (USALI) oraz wskaźników charakterystycznych dla branży hotelarskiej;
- Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności analitycznego myślenia;
- Samodzielność oraz dobra organizacja pracy;
- Odpowiedzialność i terminowość;
- Gotowość do odbywania delegacji służbowych.

jobs.title: Receptionist  (Empfangskraft)

Receptionist

Company Description

Our heart beats turquoise.

Working at Motel One is like coming home to friends, where you can be your true self and where appreciation and support matter. We meet on an equal footing and see ourselves as one team: from our management to our trainees.

We create a home away from home for our guests with our shared passion for modern design and high-quality service. Our more than 100 hotels in 14 countries impress with exclusive design, high service standards and first-class inner-city locations at an attractive price.

As the founder and pioneer of the budget design concept, we are successfully expanding in the metropolises of Europe and beyond. Become part of our team and develop Motel One with us.

Job Description

As a Receptionist, you are the first and last impression of our hotel, placing the guest at the centre of everything you do. You will deliver a warm, genuine and professional welcome, ensuring every interaction creates a positive and memorable experience. From managing check-ins and check-outs to responding to guest enquiries and resolving requests with care and efficiency, you will provide exceptional service while working collaboratively with your colleagues to exceed guest expectations. You will take pride in creating a welcoming atmosphere, anticipating guests' needs and ensuring every stay reflects the high standards and hospitality of Motel One.

jobs.description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship

- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future

jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRING: Senior Network Hand & Feet Engineer (L2/L3 Physical & Logical Support) – Austria

Excis is a global leader in IT support that is characterized by innovation and collaboration. We are looking for an experienced Senior Network Hand & Feet Engineerwho will be responsible for the end-to-end physical deployment and logical validation of network infrastructures. This position requires in-depth knowledge of OSI layers 1-3to ensure that physical connectivity seamlessly matches logical configurations. Become part of a supportive and growth-oriented company where your technical expertise makes a real difference.

190+ countries | 6,000+ Engineers | 200+ Enterprise Customers

We promote an open, collaborative and growth-oriented corporate culture in which individual achievements contribute to mutual success. From solving complex technical challenges to supporting global enterprise customers, our people are at the heart of it.

Your tasks

- Perform challenging rack and device installations using Rack Elevation Diagrams (REDs) for Cisco Nexus 9k, Catalyst 9500, and other networking components.
- Ensuring mechanical safety, correct power supply and rack integrity.
- Perform structured copper and fiber cabling including SMF/MMF fibers, SFP/SFP+/QSFP+ modules, and ANSI/TIA 606-B cabling.
- Manage patch panels, cross-connect, and coordinate line extensions with telecom providers.
- Configure and troubleshoot out-of-band (OOB) management and console accesses.
- Support for BIOS-based error analysis and on-site boot monitoring.
- Apply in-depth routing and switching knowledge to OSI layers 1-3, including VLANs, STP, EtherChannel/LACP, and protocol validation (BGP, OSPF).
- Collaborate with NOC and infrastructure teams to resolve business-critical network disruptions.

Requirements

- 6-8 years of work experience in a data center or large enterprise campus environment
- Experience installing Ethernet and fiber cabling on Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto and F5 load balancers
- Hands-on experience with routing and switching as well as Cisco IOS, NX-OS, PAN OS or Arista EOS
- Experience in working with Visual Fault Locators (VFL), Light Meters and Fiber Inspection Scopes
- CCNA-Zertifizierung erforderlich; CCNP Enterprise (ENCORE) von Vorteil
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit geschäftskritischen Incidents in Enterprise-Netzwerken und Rechenzentren
- Bereitschaft zur Vor-Ort-Arbeit von Montag bis Freitag (kein Hybrid- oder Remote-Modell)
- Lokale Sprachkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Wichtige Kompetenzen

- Erweiterte Fehleranalyse auf den OSI-Schichten 1–3
- Präzision bei physischer Installation und Verkabelungsstandards
- Ausgeprägte Dokumentations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
- Selbstständiges Arbeiten vor Ort
- Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden IT-Teams

Warum Excis?

Bei Excis zählt Ihre Arbeit. Sie werden Teil eines dynamischen, praxisorientierten Teams, in dem Ihr technisches Fachwissen direkt zur Kundenzufriedenheit und zum Unternehmenserfolg beiträgt.

Wir bieten Ihnen ein unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, kontinuierlichem Lernen und der Zusammenarbeit mit modernsten Technologien. Freuen Sie sich auf eine attraktive Vergütung und die Chance, bei einem globalen IT-Dienstleister mitzuwirken, der Innovation und Exzellenz lebt.

Bereit für den nächsten Karriereschritt? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und werden Sie Teil von Excis – gemeinsam liefern wir erstklassigen IT-Support für Enterprise-Kunden weltweit!

Nurse

Stellenbeschreibung:
Job Title: Nurse

International SOS is the world’s leading medical and security services company with over 12,000 employees working in 1,000 locations in 90 countries. International SOS Government Services administers the TRICARE Overseas Program providing high-quality, accessible health care services for U.S. Military service members, family members, retirees, and other eligible beneficiaries overseas.

About the role

- Perhaps you live abroad and would like to return to Poland?
- Do you have a Polish nursing license?
- Looking to apply your experience in a new environment?
- Is it time to move away from the demands of clinical care in a hospital environment?
- Do you speak Polish and English?

We are looking for a Nurse (known internally as a Near Patient Nurse) based in Poznan or within proximity, to support our global patient care program, TRICARE. You will be responsible for providing medical case management for patients, visiting them at healthcare provider sites, writing medical reports and providing medical updates.

This is a fantastic opportunity for nurses to move away from the demands of a clinical environment to an on-site case manager role using their medical expertise.

- The nurse would provide comprehensive in-patient clinical case management
- Develop and maintain effective relationships with providers, (medical and administrative) internal and external stakeholders and suppliers to ensure excellent delivery of service
- Regularly visit or contact the care providers (civilian and military treatment facility centers) to obtain updates for medical cases
- Liaise with patients to obtain detailed clinical information including past medical history to allow for accurate on-going case management
- Support the medical collection team in obtaining the discharge summary and medical records from the care provider

About you

- Registered General Nurse or equivalent with minimum 3 years of experience with registration to practice in Poland
- Recognized qualification to minimum diploma level or equivalence in practice demonstrated through portfolio/CV
- A demonstrable commitment to professional development
- Able to communicate Polish and proficiently in English
- Own a car and have a clean license
- Passionate about international healthcare

- 15,900 PLN car allowance per annum

- Structured career development track, with opportunities for progression and advancement
- Warm, supportive, and open company culture
- An opportunity to thrive in a global environment
- We celebrate diversity on a global scale and encourage every colleague to bring their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion and equal support

At International SOS, we offer a great working environment, thanks to our commitment to flexible working, diversity, and development.  We encourage every person to be their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion, equality and support.

jobs.title: AI Manager (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Willst du KI in echten geschäftlichen Mehrwert für die DLG verwandeln? Als **AI Manager (m/w/d)** spielst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Group IT. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, die KI‑Strategie der DLG weiterzuentwickeln und umzusetzen – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen. In dieser Rolle treibst du nicht nur die Richtung und Umsetzung von KI‑Initiativen voran, sondern baust auch ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf und führst es. Du schaffst die Grundlage dafür, wie wir KI‑Lösungen entwickeln, skalieren und im gesamten Unternehmen betreiben.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du prägst die KI‑Ausrichtung der DLG und leitest ein Team, das wirkungsvolle, geschäftsorientierte Lösungen liefert. Konkret bedeutet das:

- Du definierst und verantwortest die KI‑Roadmap sowie das Use‑Case‑Portfolio über alle Geschäftsbereiche hinweg.
- Du baust ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf, führst und entwickelst es weiter.
- Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare und wirkungsvolle KI‑Lösungen.
- Du steuerst das Solution Design – von der Idee über Architekturentscheidungen bis zur Implementierung.
- Du etablierst Standards für Daten, Integrationen, Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und Responsible AI.
- Du arbeitest eng mit technischen Teams, externen Partnern und Dienstleistern zusammen, um Fortschritt und Qualität sicherzustellen.
- Du unterstützt Build-or-Buy‑Entscheidungen und sorgst für die Abstimmung mit den Enterprise‑Plattformen.

Profil

Du bist eine erfahrene **Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit einer starken technischen Basis und einer Leidenschaft dafür, sowohl Menschen als auch Lösungen weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest strukturiert und pragmatisch und erzielst Ergebnisse sowohl durch dein Team als auch durch deine eigene Expertise. Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Business und IT und weißt, wie man Richtung, Alignment und Momentum in einem komplexen Stakeholder‑Umfeld schafft.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du:

- nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams im Bereich KI, Daten oder Advanced Analytics mitbringen
- ein tiefes Verständnis für Solution Architecture und komplexe IT‑Landschaften haben
- Erfahrung darin haben, KI‑ oder Dateninitiativen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung zu treiben
- in der Lage sein, geschäftliche Prioritäten mit technologischen Möglichkeiten zu verbinden
- Erfahrung mit Governance, Priorisierung und funktionsübergreifenden Entscheidungen haben
- eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit sein, die motiviert, coacht und Engagement schafft
- strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert arbeiten
- klar kommunizieren und komplexe Themen verständlich machen
- sicher in Deutsch und Englisch kommunizieren

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG erwartet dich eine spannende und wirkungsvolle Rolle in einem Unternehmen, in dem KI und Digitalisierung ganz oben auf der Agenda stehen.

Du kannst dich freuen auf:

- eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der KI‑Ausrichtung eines internationalen Unternehmens
- die Möglichkeit, eine neue KI‑Funktion innerhalb der DLG aufzubauen und zu führen
- ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Einfluss
- ein starkes professionelles Umfeld in IT, Daten und Digitalisierung
- persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und eine gesunde Work‑Life‑Balance

Kontakt

jobs.title: Integration Developer (m/w/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Möchtest du eine Schlüsselrolle in einem der größten und ambitioniertesten Unternehmen Dänemarks übernehmen – in einem eingespielten Integrationsteam, in dem du Verantwortung, Freiheit und echten Einfluss darauf erhältst, wie DLG sein digitales Geschäft in ganz Europa vernetzt?

In der DLG Group IT bringen wir Business und Technologie zusammen. Wir entwerfen, entwickeln und implementieren Integrationen, die Systeme über DLG und unsere europäischen Tochtergesellschaften hinweg nahtlos miteinander verbinden. Wir erweitern unser Team und suchen einen Integration Developer (m/w/d), der leidenschaftlich gerne elegante, effiziente und zukunftssichere Lösungen entwickelt.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

DLG befindet sich mitten in einer spannenden digitalen Transformation. Unsere hybride Integrationsplattform, aufgebaut auf SAP und Microsoft Azure, unterstützt unter anderem ReGen, ein strategisches Transformationsprogramm, in dem Daten, Automatisierung und Innovation Hand in Hand gehen.

Wir entwickeln aktiv unseren Digital Integration Hub weiter und bewegen uns in Richtung einer stärker ereignisgesteuerten Architektur. Als Integration Developer wirst du Teil des Teams, das diese Vision Realität werden lässt – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, Business-Stakeholdern und Tochtergesellschaften in ganz Europa.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und Technologie und gestaltest mit, wie Daten und Prozesse innerhalb der DLG fließen. Deine Hauptaufgaben umfassen:

- Design, Entwicklung und Implementierung von End-to-End‑Integrationen, die Systeme miteinander verbinden
- Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung des Digital Integration Hub sowie an ereignisgesteuerten Integrationsmustern
- Technischer Sparringspartner für Projekte und Tochtergesellschaften in der gesamten Organisation
- Mitgestaltung und Nutzung von KI‑gestützten Funktionen innerhalb der Integrationslandschaft

Profil

Du arbeitest gerne an der Schnittstelle von Technologie und Business und möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, in dem Integrationen eine zentrale Rolle bei der digitalen Transformation einer internationalen Organisation spielen. In dieser Rolle bringst du sowohl technisches Verständnis als auch eine kollaborative Arbeitsweise mit.

Wir stellen uns vor, dass du Folgendes mitbringst:

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Integrationsentwicklung oder in vergleichbaren Rollen
- Erfahrung mit dem Microsoft‑Azure‑Integrationsstack oder der SAP Integration Suite – und die Motivation, deine Kompetenzen weiter auszubauen
- Sicherheit darin, Geschäftsanforderungen in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen
- Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Stakeholdern
- Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse, in Wort und Schrift

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG wirst du Teil eines kleinen, starken Integrationsteams, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Professionalität und Einfluss Hand in Hand gehen. Du bist weder ein kleines Zahnrad in einer großen Maschine, noch wirst du mit Verantwortung allein gelassen. Stattdessen arbeitest du eng mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und spielst eine zentrale Rolle dabei, Systeme, Daten und Geschäftsprozesse in einer internationalen Unternehmensgruppe zu verbinden.

Wir bieten dir eine Rolle mit einer engen Verbindung zwischen Ideen und Umsetzung – in einem Umfeld, in dem Neugier, Feedback und Wissensaustausch zum Arbeitsalltag gehören. Konkret kannst du dich auf Folgendes freuen:

- Ein eingespieltes Team engagierter Integrationsspezialisten, das sowohl mit SAP‑ als auch mit Microsoft‑Azure‑Technologien arbeitet
- Breite technologische Einblicke über mehrere ERP‑Plattformen, Geschäftsbereiche und Integrationsmuster hinweg
- Die Möglichkeit, aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung des Digital Integration Hub beizutragen und den Weg hin zu einer stärker ereignisgesteuerten Architektur mitzugestalten
- Arbeitszeiten am Tag, keine Rufbereitschaft und ein gesundes Work‑Life‑Balance‑Umfeld
- Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen sowie attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen, einschließlich betrieblicher Altersvorsorge und weiterer Benefits

We are recruiting for a skilled E-Bike Mechanic to join a growing urban mobility team in Paris. - Fluent in French; good English is an advantage. Communication should be clear and customer-focused.

jobs.title: Hepatologist with liver transplant experience for a university hospital
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. About the department

The department is one of the largest and most specialized units within gastroenterology and hepatology in the Nordic region. It provides both emergency and elective care and works closely with several highly specialized disciplines.

You will become part of an international team of approximately ten specialist physicians with diverse professional backgrounds and areas of expertise. Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to the department's culture.

The unit manages a broad spectrum of hepatology cases, including advanced liver disease and liver transplantation, while maintaining a strong focus on clinical excellence, education, and research.

Your role

As a specialist in gastroenterology and hepatology, you will:

    Assess, diagnose, and treat patients with complex liver diseases
    Participate in both outpatient and inpatient hepatology care
    Work closely with multidisciplinary teams involved in advanced liver treatment and transplantation
    Contribute to teaching and supervision of junior colleagues and medical students
    Participate in quality improvement initiatives and departmental development
    Take part in on-call duties together with experienced colleagues

Qualifications

We are looking for a candidate who has:

    EU-recognized specialist certification in Gastroenterology and Hepatology
    At least five years of experience working as a specialist physician
    Experience in hepatology and management of advanced liver diseases
    Experience related to liver transplantation
    Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
    The ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment

Research experience, academic involvement, or a PhD is considered an advantage.

Why work here?

This opportunity combines highly specialized medicine with an excellent quality of life.

The region offers:

    Easy access to coastlines, nature, and outdoor activities
    A vibrant cultural scene and excellent public services
    International connections and modern infrastructure
    A safe and family-friendly environment
    Excellent opportunities for long-term professional development

You will work in a progressive healthcare setting where innovation, education, research, and high-quality patient care are closely integrated.

What Dignus Medical offers you:

    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
    Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
    Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
    Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Take the next step in your career

This is an excellent opportunity for experienced hepatologists with liver transplantation experience who want to work in a highly specialized and progressive environment while enjoying a high quality of life.

Don’t hesitate to contact me. I look forward to hearing from you and helping you find the perfect job that matches your experience and ambitions.



Application

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the final application date.

Submit your application today and include:

    CV / résumé
    Diploma and educational certificates/ Proof of professional license/registration
    Motivation letter

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're looking for a Director, Product Design to lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, reporting to the Co-Founder & Head of Design.

This is a true player-coach role for someone who loves building products as much as leading people. You'll lead and develop a talented team of product designers while remaining deeply embedded in the work itself. You'll whiteboard with designers, navigate complex product decisions.

The Co-Founder & Head of Design remains closely involved in design critique and product quality. Your role is to lead the day-to-day design organization by creating the structure, alignment, and momentum that enable exceptional work. You'll stay two to three layers deeper than the Co-Founder & Head of Design on active initiatives, surfacing the context, tradeoffs, and insights needed to make thoughtful decisions without requiring constant immersion in every project.

Success in this role requires exceptional product judgment, strong design taste, technical fluency, and a collaborative approach. You're someone who naturally connects disciplines, elevates the people around you, and makes both the work and the team better every day.

 
 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, ensuring work is aligned, prioritized, and delivered to an exceptionally high standard.

 - Manage, mentor, and develop a team of product designers, helping them grow their craft, confidence, and impact.

 - Shape and elevate the customer journey

 - Work alongside designers every day by whiteboarding ideas, exploring alternatives, reviewing work in progress, and solving complex product and interaction challenges.

 - Stay deeply informed across active initiatives, surfacing the context and insights that enable the Co-Founder & Head of Design to engage quickly in meaningful design critique and high-impact product decisions.

 - Raise the quality of product design through thoughtful feedback, exceptional craft, and strong design taste.

 - Help evolve Replit's design practices, workflows, and team culture while preserving the speed and flexibility of a high-growth company.

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard exceptional product design talent as the organization grows.

 
 


WHO YOU ARE

You're a builder first and a manager second.

You enjoy being close to the work, helping designers think through difficult problems, and making good teams even better. You're equally comfortable sketching ideas on a whiteboard, giving thoughtful design feedback, coaching a designer through a difficult challenge, or partnering with engineering on implementation details.

You combine exceptional product judgment with strong design taste and technical fluency. You're collaborative, humble, curious, and energized by helping great work happen.

 
 


EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant experience leading product design teams within high-growth technology companies.

 - Proven ability to balance people leadership with meaningful hands-on product design contribution.

 - A portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft, interaction design, product thinking, and systems thinking.

 - Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to deliver technically sophisticated products.

 - Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product development in fast-moving environments.

 - Exceptional communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

 - Strong design taste, sound judgment, and a bias toward action.

 - Experience simplifying complex technical products into elegant, approachable user experiences.

 
 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience designing developer tools, technical products, or software creation platforms.

 - Experience building AI-powered products or AI-native workflows.

 - Coding experience or strong technical curiosity.

 - Experience growing design teams in startup or scale-up environments.

 - Active use of AI throughout your design process.

 
 


WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

This isn't a traditional design leadership role.

We're looking for someone who thrives in the work, not above it. Someone who enjoys solving problems alongside designers, building strong partnerships across Product and Engineering, and bringing the depth of context that allows the Co-Founder & Head of Design to focus on the moments where their perspective has the greatest impact.

This is a role for someone who is excited by complex product challenges, passionate about developing exceptional designers, and motivated by building products that make powerful technology feel intuitive.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

A leading university hospital in southwestern Sweden is now recruiting specialists in pediatric ophthalmology to strengthen its highly specialized eye care department. This is an exciting opportunity to work with advanced diagnostics and nationally designated care for pediatric glaucoma and cataract, while contributing to education, clinical development, and research within one of Sweden’s foremost ophthalmology units.

About the role

You will join a large ophthalmology department with more than 250 professionals, covering outpatient care, emergency eye services, inpatient wards, and surgical units. The pediatric ophthalmology section provides comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic care for children and collaborates closely with electrophysiology and hereditary disease units.

You will work in multidisciplinary teams that include physicians, orthoptists, nurses, optometrists, and technicians, all focused on delivering patient-centered, high-quality eye care. As part of a university hospital, you will also have the opportunity to participate in teaching, clinical research, and innovation projects.

Requirements

    EU-recognized specialist certification in ophthalmology
    Minimum five years of clinical experience in ophthalmology
    Focus and competence in pediatric ophthalmology
    Strong interest in teaching, research, and clinical development
    Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Swedish
    Team-oriented, responsible, and committed to providing high-quality patient care
    Experience or competence in medical retina is considered an advantage

Language and relocation support

    A willingness and motivation to learn Swedish is important for your integration and clinical work.
    The relocation process begins once you reach language level B2. During this stage, you will work 50% clinically and study 50% Swedish until you achieve C1 level, which is required to apply for a Swedish specialist license (specialistbevis) to practice as a specialist doctor.
    Language training is provided free of charge once you have accepted an employment offer.
    You will receive full support throughout the licensing and relocation process, including assistance with documentation, Swedish authorization, and settling in Sweden.

What Dignus Medical offers you

    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
    Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
    Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family

    You’ll have time for both professional development and personal wellbeing.

Ready to take the next step in your career?
