jobs.title: Arbetsmarknadskonsulent - Vikariat
jobs.description:
Vi söker dig som vill vara en del av vår resa mot en bättre vardag, starkare framtid och ökad livskvalitet för invånarna i Perstorp. Hos oss får du en arbetsplats där arbetsglädje, engagemang och utveckling är en självklar del av vardagen. Vi tror på att tänka nytt, arbeta smart och hela tiden bli lite bättre tillsammans.

Perstorps kommun ligger i hjärtat av norra Skåne, mitt i den dynamiska Öresundsregionen – ett av Sveriges mest expansiva områden. Här kombineras småstadens närhet och trygghet med närhet till både naturupplevelser och större städer. Kommunen har cirka 7 300 invånare och omkring 560 medarbetare som tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt.

Vi är stolta över vårt starka näringsliv och vårt fokus på folkhälsa, hållbarhet och livskvalitet. Här finns goda möjligheter att påverka, utvecklas och göra skillnad varje dag.

Beskrivning

Arbetsmarknadsenhetens främsta uppdrag är att aktivt arbeta för att fler invånare blir självförsörjda och samtidigt hjälpa de lokala företagen att få rätt kompetens. Genom samordnade insatser stöttas invånare utan arbete till att stärka sin ställning på arbetsmarknaden, och genom arbete eller studier i slutändan stå för sin egen försörjning. Arbetsmarknadsenheten (AME) erbjuder olika arbetsmarknadsinsatser så som praktik, individuell vägledning, gruppvägledning och matchning mot offentliga såväl som privata arbetsgivare.

Samverkan är av största vikt för verksamheten. Framförallt med kommunens andra verksamheter men även med Arbetsförmedlingen, Försäkringskassan, sjukvården och de 11 kommunerna inom Familjen Helsingborg-nätverket. Projekt bedrivs också genom FINSAM NNV Skåne.

Arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker nu två arbetsmarknadskonsulenter till vårt team med huvudsakligt fokus på grupp- och individuell vägledning.  Tjänsterna omfattar allt förekommande arbete inom verksamheten med syfte att karltägga och utreda individens förutsättningar för arbete, och genom vägledning och insatskoordinering stötta individen till en hållbar förankring på arbetsmarknaden  Stort fokus ligger på arbete med klienter som anvisats från socialtjänsten och som uppbär försörjningsstöd.

Som medarbetare på Arbetsmarknadsenheten ingår du i ett team där vi genom engagemang, service och professionellt bemötande, arbetar tillsammans för att nå våra uppsatta verksamhetsmål. Vår verksamhet bygger på tillit, respekt och förståelse för varandra och en positiv anda.

Arbetet innebär bland annat:

    I samarbete med andra utreda, planera, koordinera och genomföra olika typer av arbetsmarknadsinsatser.
    Motivera, vägleda och stötta klienter till att stärka sin ställning på arbetsmarknaden, med slutmålet att bli självförsörjande.
    Höga krav på dokumentation och uppföljning, samt ett kvalitetsansvar genom hela processen.
    Samverkan med interna, externa och/eller anvisande aktörer kring gemensamma klienter.
    Kontakt med arbetsgivare för att vara behjälplig i rekryteringsprocessen och tillgodose de kompetensbehov som finns genom matchning mot deltagare.
    Du kommer vara delaktig i verksamhetens utveckling och har möjlighet att påverka processer.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig med adekvat utbildning på högskolenivå eller annan kompetens/erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig och relevant för tjänsten. Du har minst två års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet och även erfarenhet av relationsbyggande arbete i syfte att utveckla och upprätthålla goda relationer till olika samarbetsaktörer.

Personliga egenskaper

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du inneha följande egenskaper/förmågor:

    Lyhördhet och kommunikativ förmåga i mötet med klienter för att skapa och bibehålla en god och professionell relation.
    God samarbetsförmåga, där respekt, tillit och prestigelöshet är av största vikt.
    Administrativ förmåga och datorvana, utifrån höga krav på dokumentation i verksamhetssystem och omfattande digital kommunikation i rådande läge.
    Initiativtagande till att sätta igång aktiviteter, uppnå resultat och även slutföra det som påbörjats.
    God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift. Övriga språkkunskaper är meriterande men ej krav.

Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

Tjänsten är ett vikariat på 1 år.

Inför rekryteringen har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringsvägar och publiceringskanaler, varför vi vänligen undanber oss all kontakt med försäljare i detta ärende.

jobs.title: Vakthavande befäl till anstalt och häkte Skänninge, tillsvidareanställning
jobs.description:
Om Kriminalvården

Kriminalvården växer – vi bygger nytt, bygger om och bygger till och söker nu fler medarbetare. Vårt viktigaste mål är att minska återfall i brott – att bryta den onda cirkeln. Lyckas vi med det blir samhället tryggare och säkrare för alla. Vi är den myndighet som ansvarar för anstalter, frivård, häkten och klienttransporter.

Läs mer om Anstalten Skänninges verksamhet på vår hemsida: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/kontakt/hitta-ochkontakta/verksamhet/anstalt/skanninge/#verksamhet

Arbetsbeskrivning

Som vakthavande befäl ansvarar du, i samråd med kriminalvårdsinspektörerna, för den operativa säkerheten på verksamhetsområde Skänninge. Du leder och fördelar de dagliga arbetsuppgifterna, med särskilt fokus på säkerhetsarbetet. Tjänsten är omväxlande och kan innebära perioder med högt tempo och många parallella frågor. Vakthavande befäl tjänstgör alla veckans dagar och är, utanför kontorstid, högsta operativa beslutsfattare på plats under kriminalvårdschef i beredskap. Du har ett övergripande ansvar inom hela verksamhetsområdet, representerar Kriminalvården och säkerställer att chefslinjen upprätthålls ut till all personal. Du säkerställer att beslut kommuniceras klart och tydligt, stödjer kriminalvårdsinspektörerna och skapar förutsättningar för en säker och välfungerande arbetsmiljö.

I rollen som vakthavande befäl kommer du bland annat att leda och följa upp det dagliga säkerhetsarbetet samt vid behov vidta åtgärder, utveckla och använda system för att följa upp säkerhetsinsatser, ha det operativa ledningsansvaret inom VO Skänninge samt ta kommandot vid incidenter och säkerställa en tydlig arbetsledning. Du kommer även att bedöma bemanningsbehov och fördela personal för dagens verksamhet, se till att visitationer genomförs enligt gällande rutiner, delta vid in- och utskrivningar, följa upp att säkerhetsrutiner efterlevs och arbeta för ständiga förbättringar. Dessutom kommer du att planera och samordna transporter, genomföra övningar, säkerhetssamtal och säkerhetsbedömningar, samverka med säkerhetsorganisationen för att stärka och upprätthålla säkerhetsarbetet samt bemanna uppkomna vakanser och säkerställa en fungerande drift.



Kvalifikationer

Dina personliga egenskaper är viktiga för oss. Vi söker dig som är trygg, stabil och har god självinsikt. I ditt yrkesutövande har du ett gott omdöme, där du har förmåga att göra korrekta avvägningar och prioriteringar i situationer. Du har förmåga att engagera och leda andra i arbetet, samtidigt som du kan anpassa ditt agerande och ditt ledarskap till olika situationer med lojalitet till kriminalvårdens uppdrag och regelverk. Det är viktigt att du har god förmåga att prioritera ditt arbete på ett rationellt sätt under stress eller hög arbetsbelastning samtidigt som du bibehåller en god säkerhetsmedvetenhet.

Eftersom du, i samråd med kriminalvårdsinspektörerna, operativt leder arbetet på anstalten och häktet samt har nära kontakt med övriga kollegor i verksamheten, behöver du ha mycket god samarbetsförmåga och förmåga att kommunicera rakt och tydligt för att bidra till en trygg och effektiv arbetsmiljö. Rollen kräver dessutom en fysisk förmåga som gör att du kan agera om situationen så kräver.

För att trivas och lyckas i ditt uppdrag är det viktigt att du delar Kriminalvårdens grundläggande värderingar om en human människosyn, respekt för individen och tron på att människan är utvecklingsbar. Du är även medveten om och har förståelse för hur bakgrund, kultur och grupptillhörighet påverkar dig själv och andra. Vidare förväntas du med ditt förhållningssätt bidra till att alla blir likvärdigt bemötta. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Vi söker dig som har:

    Fullständig gymnasieskolekompetens i form av slutbetyg eller gymnasieexamen
    Godkänd kriminalvårdsutbildning
    Erfarenhet av arbete inom kriminalvården
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska språket i såväl tal som skrift
    B-körkort



Det är även meriterande med:

    Genomgått Kriminalvårdens interna vakthavande befälsutbildning alternativt andra ledarskapsutbildningar som Kriminalvården bedömer relevant i relation till befattningen
    Genomgått utbildning i OC- och batong samt larmchef
    Varit verksam som vakthavande befäl inom kriminalvården de senaste fem åren.
    Erfarenhet av att utbilda personal inom säkerhet, exempelvis inom OC- och batong eller konflikthantering
    Erfarenhet av att leda personal



Övrigt

Kriminalvården har valt att ta bort det personliga brevet och ersatt det med urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Svaren i urvalsfrågorna och CV ligger till grund för om du är kvalificerad att gå vidare i processen.

För att bli aktuell för anställning inom Kriminalvården krävs att du motsvarar högt ställda krav gällande lämplighet, omdöme, säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetande och att du följer gällande lagar. Det innebär att du står upp för demokratiska värderingar och den statliga värdegrund som gäller för Kriminalvårdens verksamhet.

Vissa befattningar är placerade i säkerhetsklass och då kommer en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas. För vissa säkerhetsklassade tjänster krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Kriminalvården välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Läs mer om säkerhetsprövning här: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocessen/sakerhetsprovning-vid-rekrytering/

Befattningen kan innebära krigsplacering vid Kriminalvården. Läs mer om krigsplacering här: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocessen/krigsplacering/

Individuell lönesättning tillämpas.

Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.

Kriminalvården strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ökad mångfald.

För att skicka in din ansökan, klicka på ansökningslänken i annonsen. Frågor om hur du ansöker och lägger in ditt CV ställer du direkt till Varbi. Frågor om specifika jobb besvaras av den kontaktperson som anges i annonsen.

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av rekryteringsannonser. Kriminalvården har upphandlade avtal.

jobs.title: Ophthalmologist opportunity in a unique Nordic archipelago

Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Ophthalmologist in a Unique Archipelago Environment

We are looking for someone who:

jobs.title: Skyddsassistent till skyddat boende  timanställning
jobs.description:
Skyddsassistent – timanställning vid behov

Vill du vara med och skapa trygghet för människor som behöver skydd?

We care for you är mer än ett uttryck för oss.

Carria vill vara en trygg och professionell aktör i vardagen för människor som befinner sig i utsatta och komplexa livssituationer, bland annat till följd av våld i nära relation, hedersrelaterat våld, utsatthet som brottsoffer eller en önskan att lämna kriminella miljöer.

Genom trygghet, professionellt stöd och ett starkt säkerhetsfokus vill vi skapa bättre förutsättningar för individen att återfå kontroll, bygga självständighet och ta steg vidare i livet. För oss handlar det om att kombinera omtanke med professionalism, närvaro med tydliga gränser och ett mänskligt bemötande med ett starkt säkerhetstänk.

Om Carria

Carria är ett IVO-tillståndspliktigt skyddat boende som erbjuder trygga och individanpassade insatser för vuxna, barn och familjer med skyddsbehov.

Vårt arbete bygger på hög kvalitet, professionella och kunskapsbaserade arbetssätt samt ett starkt fokus på trygghet, säkerhet och individens behov.

Carria befinner sig i en fas där verksamheten växer och utvecklas. Därför söker vi nu 1–2 skyddassistenter för timanställning vid behov som vill vara med och bidra i vårt dagliga arbete och på vår fortsatta resa.

Det här är en roll för dig som redan har erfarenhet av att arbeta med människor med skyddsbehov och som känner dig trygg i den typen av verksamhet.

Om rollen

Som skyddsassistent är du en viktig del av det dagliga arbetet på Carria. Tillsammans med dina kollegor bidrar du till en trygg, stabil och säker vardag för våra klienter.

Rollen är varierad och arbetsuppgifterna utgår från verksamhetens och klienternas aktuella behov. Det kan bland annat innebära att finnas tillgänglig för klienterna, ge praktiskt och socialt stöd, bidra till struktur i vardagen, följa säkerhetsrutiner, uppmärksamma förändringar och föra relevant information vidare till ansvariga kollegor.

Dokumentation och andra praktiska uppgifter ingår också när det behövs för att vardagen och verksamheten ska fungera.

Du har inte ett eget klientansvar, utan arbetar som en del av teamet och utifrån verksamhetens rutiner, planering och ditt ansvarsområde. Beredskap ingår i rollen enligt fast schema.

För oss är det viktigt att du ser vad som behöver göras, tar ansvar och vet när något behöver lyftas vidare.

Vi söker dig som

För rollen krävs högskoleutbildning om minst 180 hp, exempelvis socionom, beteendevetare eller annan relevant utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.

Du behöver också ha tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med människor i utsatta livssituationer. Vi söker inte dig som vill prova området för första gången.

Erfarenhet från exempelvis skyddat boende, våld i nära relation, hedersrelaterat våld och förtryck, socialtjänst, HVB, stödboende, kvinnojour eller annan verksamhet med skydds- och säkerhetsfokus är särskilt relevant.

Du har god förståelse för vad det innebär att möta människor som kan befinna sig i kris, oro eller under hot och förstår vikten av säkerhet, sekretess, integritet och ett professionellt förhållningssätt.

Du har god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift och B-körkort är ett krav.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av

    Skyddat boende och säkerhetsarbete.
    Våld i nära relation samt hedersrelaterat våld och förtryck.
    Socialtjänstens arbete och myndighetsutövning.
    HVB eller stödboende.
    Kris- och traumaarbete.
    Barn och familjer i utsatta livssituationer.
    Riskbedömning och säkerhetsplanering.
    Samverkan med socialtjänst, polis, skola, hälso- och sjukvård eller andra samhällsaktörer.
    Social dokumentation och genomförandeplaner.
    Flerspråkighet, utöver svenska och engelska.
    Kunskap om eller erfarenhet av exempelvis FREDA, PATRIARK, SARA, SAM, BRA, TMO eller MI.

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är trygg, lugn och ansvarstagande. Du har ett respektfullt och professionellt bemötande och kan skapa förtroende utan att göra avkall på tydliga gränser.

Du kan arbeta självständigt när situationen kräver det, men är framför allt en lagspelare som kommunicerar tydligt och samarbetar med dina kollegor.

Du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig när förutsättningarna förändras. Du arbetar strukturerat utifrån verksamhetens rutiner och din roll, samtidigt som du är uppmärksam på vad som behöver göras och tar initiativ inom ditt ansvarsområde.

Du behöver kunna möta människor med olika bakgrunder och kulturella referensramar med respekt, lyhördhet och professionalism.

Personlig lämplighet kommer att väga tungt i vår bedömning.

Väx med Carria

Carria är i en utvecklings- och tillväxtfas. Vi bygger vår verksamhet vidare och vill hitta medarbetare som vill vara med på vår fortsatta resa.

Tjänsten är initialt en timanställning vid behov, men för rätt person finns möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med Carria i takt med att verksamheten växer.

Vi uppskattar medarbetare som tar ansvar, kommer med idéer och vill bidra till att utveckla både arbetssätt och verksamhet. I takt med verksamhetens utveckling kan det därför finnas möjlighet till större ansvar och fler arbetsuppgifter för den som vill och har rätt förutsättningar.

Arbetstid

Vi söker 1–2 skyddassistenter för timanställning vid behov.

Arbetstiderna är oregelbundna och varierar utifrån verksamhetens behov. Arbetspass kan förekomma på olika dagar och tider och omfattningen kan variera över tid.

Beredskap ingår i rollen enligt fast schema.

Vi ser gärna att du har möjlighet att vara flexibel när verksamheten behöver förstärkning.

Ansökan

Sista ansökningsdag: 30 september 2026.

Vi intervjuar och gör urval löpande under ansökningstiden. Tjänsten kan därför komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag och innan annonsen har hunnit löpa ut. Skicka därför gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Eftersom Carria bedriver ett IVO-tillståndspliktigt skyddat boende genomförs registerkontroll som en del av rekryteringsprocessen. Registerkontroll av personal genomförs enligt gällande regler och ska vara genomförd innan anställning.

I din ansökan skickar du:

    CV
    Personligt brev
    En kort beskrivning av varför du vill arbeta som skyddsassistent hos Carria.

Ange referens: Skyddsassistent

Ansökan skickas till info@carria.se

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.

Carria – We care for you.

jobs.title: Mitarbeiter:in Arbeitsanleitung Holz
jobs.description:
Die Emmausgemeinschaft St. Pölten unterstützt sozial benachteiligte Menschen bei der sozialen und beruflichen Integration in die Gesellschaft. Unser Verein betreibt Einrichtungen an neun Standorten in St. Pölten, begleitet Menschen in herausfordernden Lebenslagen und bietet bei Bedarf auch ein Zuhause auf Zeit. Dazu verfügen wir über ein Netzwerk aus Notschlafstellen, Tageszentren, Wohnhäusern, einer Beratungsstelle, Arbeits- und Beschäftigungsplätzen sowie Tagesstätten.

Die Tagesstätte Viehofen unterstützt Menschen mit psychischen Beeinträchtigungen im Lebensbereich Arbeit sowie beim Aufbau sozialer und gesundheitsförderlicher Kompetenzen. Für unsere Einrichtung suchen wir eine Arbeitsanleitung in der Gruppe Holz. Die Stelle ist ab sofort mit bis zu 35 Wochenstunden zu besetzen. 1 Mitarbeiter:in Arbeitsanleitung Holz für die Tagesstätte Viehofen

Das ist Deine Arbeit bei uns

º Du leitest eine Werkgruppe in der handwerklichen Produktion (Holzbearbeitung) an.

º Du trägst die organisatorische Verantwortung (Produktentwicklung, Produktion, Materialbeschaffung).

º Du unterstützt die Umsetzung der Zielpläne der Teilnehmer:innen.

Du passt zu uns, wenn Du

º über handwerkliche Fertigkeiten in der Holzbearbeitung verfügst (Tischler:in, Zimmerer:in, Holz-Designer:in/Künstler:in oder ähnliches).

º Erfahrungen im pädagogischen oder psychosozialen Bereich besitzt.

º Eigeninitiative zeigst und Dich für Aufgaben begeisterst und aktiv mitgestalten möchtest.

º Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Menschen mit psychischer Beeinträchtigung besitzt.

Das macht einen Job bei Emmaus attraktiv

º Abwechslungsreiche und sinnstiftende Tätigkeit

Gemäß § 12 Abs. 2 des Kärntner Landes-Gleichbehandlungsgesetzes 2022 (K-LGlBG 2022), hat die Ausschreibung den Hinweis zu enthalten, dass Bewerbungen von Männern besonders erwünscht sind, weil der Anteil der Männer im Wirkungsbereich der Dienstbehörde für die ausgeschriebene Verwendung oder Funktion unter 50 Prozent liegt.

Bewerber:innen, welche die in der Ausschreibung als verpflichtend angeführten Voraussetzungen bis zum Ende der Bewerbungsfrist nicht erfüllen oder die erforderlichen Unterlagen nicht beibringen, sind in das Objektivierungsverfahren nicht einzubeziehen.

Für alle Bewerber:innen, die die in der Kärntner Landeszeitung geforderten Ausschreibungskriterien erfüllen, setzt sich das Objektivierungsverfahren aus folgenden Verfahrensschritten zusammen:

1.) Analyse und Beurteilung der Bewerbungsunterlagen. Auf Grund des Ergebnisses der Vorselektion werden die zwölf bestgereihten Bewerber:innen zu einem

2.) Interview eingeladen.

Die mathematische Zusammenführung der Ergebnisse (50 % Vorselektion, 50 % Interview) ergibt die Endreihung.

Es wird ausdrücklich darauf aufmerksam gemacht, dass ein Ersatz allfälliger Reisekosten oder Aufwendungen im Hinblick auf die Teilnahme an Auswahlverfahren nicht möglich ist.

jobs.description:
1 Mechanical Engineer Substrate Handling (all genders) Job-ID: 200758 I Work Location Model: On-site Flex I Arbeitsort: Salzburg I Work Country: Österreich

What you'll do

Substrate holder (Chuck) design

* Design and develop substrate holders (chucks) for wet chemistry processes, including plating, cleaning, and etching applications
* Define sealing concepts, panel support strategies, clamping mechanisms, and chemical exposure interfaces
* Optimize designs for uniform process conditions, minimal particle generation, and high substrate integrity (e.g. low breakage, controlled deformation)

Panel and substrate handling

* Design mechanical interfaces between substrate holders and tool automation (transfer systems, process chambers)
* Develop concepts for loading/unloading, alignment, gripping, and secure transport of panels
* Ensure safe interaction between handling systems and substrate holders to avoid damage and contamination
* Collaborate with multiple teams, e.g. automation teams on end effector and handling strategy development, and process teams on optimising process performance

Engineering development & validation

* Own full product lifecycle from concept through productization for chuck assemblies
* Perform detailed mechanical design including tolerance stack-ups, sealing interfaces, and alignment concepts
* Conduct analysis including structural, FEA, thermal effects, deformation, and vibration
* Develop and execute validation plans focusing on:
*
** Chemical compatibility (materials, coatings, seals)
** Lifetime and wear (seals, surfaces, interfaces)
** Process robustness (repeatability, alignment, uniformity)
* Drive root cause analysis and design improvements for field issues (e.g., leakage, breakage, handling failures, process failures)
* Build and support testing of prototypes in lab and tool environments
* Execute test plans to evaluate performance such as sealing, leakage, and handling robustness
* Document results and support analysis of issues and design improvements

Materials & process environment

* Select and qualify materials such as polymers, elastomers (e.g., FKM/FFKM), ceramics, metals, and coatings for harsh wet chemistry environments
* Ensure compatibility with plating chemistries, acids, solvents, and DI water processes
* Design for cleanability, maintainability, and minimal chemical retention

Manufacturing & productization

* Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing to ensure high-quality, cost-effective, and scalable designs
* Drive DFM/DFA improvements for complex assemblies such as substrate holders and handling interfaces
* Define and release complete documentation including drawings, specifications, and assembly concepts
* Perform technical design reviews and work in cross-functional project teams
* Drive standardization of substrate holder platforms and modular design concepts

Who we're looking for

Minimum qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field
* 3-5 years of experience in mechanical design or product development
* Strong experience in precision mechanical design, ideally in complex equipment or capital systems
* Proficiency in 3D CAD tools (Siemens NX, SolidEdge, or similar)
* Solid foundation in GD&T, tolerance analysis, and assembly design
* Hands-on experience in testing, debugging, and validating mechanical systems

Preferred qualifications

* Exposure to semiconductor equipment, wet processing, or plating systems
* Experience with substrate holders, chucks, or wafer/panel handling systems
* Strong understanding of:
*
** Sealing technologies (static and dynamic seals)
** Chemical compatibility and material selection
** Precision alignment and handling of fragile substrates
* Experience working with automation systems

We are looking for a talented Marketing Leader to lead our Neurovascular marketing and market development strategy across Germany, Austria and Switzerland (DACH).
This is a high-impact opportunity for an experienced, commercially minded leader who can combine strategic thinking, strong people leadership and excellent execution to drive therapy awareness, and sustainable growth.
This role will cover the DACH region and is a remote role. This means your home/remote location is the primary work location. You will travel approximately 50% of the time within DACH and internationally.

There is a facility-based immunization requirement for this position. Full measles immunization is therefore a requirement for the successful candidate.

The Opportunity
As DACH Marketing Manager - Neurovascular, you will translate global and Western European priorities into a compelling DACH strategy, while leading a team of Product and Market Development Specialists. You will connect customers, sales and cross-functional partners to identify market opportunities, improve patient pathways and workflows, and turn customer insights into meaningful business impact.

We are looking for someone who can operate confidently at both strategic and executional level, bringing clarity, energy and accountability to a complex and evolving environment.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
* Lead the DACH Neurovascular marketing and market development strategy, aligned with Western European and global objectives.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of Product and Market Development Specialists, fostering a high-performance and collaborative culture.
* Lead annual strategic planning, including budget, resource allocation and performance management.
* Translate customer, market and competitive insights into clear priorities and growth opportunities.
* Drive therapy awareness, adoption and market development across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
* Identify opportunities to improve patient pathways, clinical workflows and economics of care.
* Partner closely with Sales Leadership and the field organisation to translate strategy into commercial execution.
* Build strong relationships with healthcare professionals and key external stakeholders.
* Collaborate across Medical Education, Market Access, Clinical Research, Health Economics, Finance, Training & Education, Sales Excellence and Legal/Compliance.
* Represent Neurovascular at regional meetings, congresses and customer events.
* Monitor market and business performance and adapt strategy to maximise impact.

Required Knowledge and Experience:
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline.
* 7+ years of relevant experience in MedTech, healthcare, HCP engagement, marketing, market development or business transformation.
* Proven track record of developing and executing successful marketing or market development strategies.
* Experience leading teams and developing high-performing talent.
* Experience driving change or transformation across a regional or multi-country environment.
* Strong commercial and strategic mindset, with the ability to translate customer and market insights into business results.
* Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
* Collaborative, agile and outcome-focused approach.

Drei von drei? ¿ Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Lies weiter.

jobs.title: Family medicine specialist opportunities across Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Family medicine specialist career opportunities across Sweden

Sweden has a growing demand for specialists in General Practice / Family Medicine within primary healthcare. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, physicians from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within Swedish primary care.

We collaborate with modern primary care centres across Sweden, from smaller community clinics to larger multidisciplinary healthcare centres. Our role is to help you find a position that matches your professional interests, preferred location and work-life balance.

Primary care physicians in Sweden play a central role in the healthcare system and work with a broad variety of cases, long-term patient relationships and close collaboration with other healthcare professionals.

Professional Development

General practitioners in Sweden work in a clinically focused environment with opportunities to develop areas of special interest. Many clinics also offer opportunities to participate in teaching or supervision of junior doctors, particularly in larger healthcare centres.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a major step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process from the first conversation to being fully established in Sweden.

Your personal advisor will assist with:

    medical licensing
    relocation planning
    practical matters related to moving and settling in

Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Support for Your Family

Many physicians relocate with their families. We therefore provide guidance regarding schools, childcare, housing and everyday life in Sweden.

We can also offer support for partners seeking employment, including opportunities within healthcare where relevant.

Language Training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required.

Dignus Medical provides intensive online Swedish language training with experienced instructors. The training is flexible and adapted to your schedule.

Language courses can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children to support their integration.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and excellent public services.

Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for outdoor activities, sports and family life.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children.

Requirements

We are looking for physicians who:

    Hold an EU-recognised specialist certification in General Practice / Family Medicine
    Have good communication skills in English
    Are motivated to learn Swedish and relocate to Sweden

Interested in learning more?

We’d love to hear from you. Submit your application or contact us today to explore current openings.

Let us help you take the next step in your career as a general practitioner specialist in Sweden!

Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

The surgical pathology and cytology unit plays a central role in diagnostics by analyzing tissue and cell samples using both microscopy and advanced digital systems. The goal is to provide accurate and timely diagnostic support to clinicians, improving patient outcomes and safety.

The department is part of a larger organization within laboratory medicine and is at the forefront of digital pathology, with ongoing development in automation, robotics, and AI-driven diagnostics.

In addition to histopathology and cytology, the unit is also responsible for:

Autopsy services and morgue operations

Multidisciplinary clinical conferences

You will work in a collaborative and well-structured environment with experienced colleagues across multiple disciplines.

    Participation in clinical conferences and interdisciplinary discussions
    Autopsy

Daytime on-call service for urgent diagnostic cases is shared within the team.

Qualifications

    EU-recognized specialist certification in pathology
    Experience in surgical pathology
    Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
    Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-based environment
    A structured, collaborative, and flexible approach

Why work here?

This opportunity is located in a coastal region of central Sweden, offering a unique mix of professional development and quality of life. The area is known for:

Easy access to the sea, forests, and outdoor activities year-round

A rich industrial and cultural heritage

A safe and family-friendly environment

Good infrastructure with connections to larger cities

The working environment is modern, forward-thinking, and continuously evolving, providing excellent conditions for both professional growth and long-term career development.

Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Take the next step in your career

This is an excellent opportunity for surgical pathologists who want to work in a progressive environment while enjoying a high quality of life.

Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?

Don’t hesitate to contact me. I look forward to hearing from you and helping you find the perfect job that matches your experience and ambitions.

Apply now!

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for a **Sales Manager** to join North Resort Oy and take responsibility for the active sales of our resort services in both the Finnish and, in particular, international markets.

Your key responsibility will be to build and develop North Resorts sales, with a strong focus on international tour operators, travel agencies and other partners within the travel and tourism industry, as well as direct sales to individual customers.

You will be selling a complete **Lapland travel experience**: high-quality accommodation, restaurant services, winter and summer activities, transportation services, and carefully designed travel packages combining these elements into memorable experiences.

This is a highly hands-on, sales-driven role. We are looking for someone who is proactive, self-motivated and commercially minded. Rather than simply responding to incoming enquiries, you will actively identify new customers and business partners, reach out to them, present North Resorts services and offering, and build strong, long-term customer and partner relationships.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Actively sell North Resorts accommodation, restaurant, activity and transportation services, as well as travel packages

- Build and maintain relationships with international tour operators, travel agencies and travel trade partners

- Actively identify and acquire new international B2B clients and business partners

- Drive direct sales to individual travellers and groups

- Identify customer needs and develop suitable service packages and tailored proposals

- Prepare quotations, conduct sales negotiations and actively close deals

- Manage existing customer relationships and develop opportunities for additional and repeat sales

- Contribute to the product development and commercialisation of North Resorts services and travel packages

- Utilise sales channels, e-commerce platforms and other digital sales solutions effectively

- Actively monitor sales targets, booking levels and occupancy rates

- Participate, where relevant, in international travel trade sales events, workshops, trade fairs and client meetings

- Work closely with the Resort Manager, reception, restaurant and activity teams, as well as external marketing partners

- Monitor, analyse and report on sales performance


WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

- Proven sales experience and a track record of achieving results in customer-facing roles

- A strong sales mindset and genuine motivation for active new customer acquisition

- The ability to build and develop long-term customer and business partnerships

- Excellent customer service, communication and negotiation skills

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Strong digital skills and the ability to work effectively with various sales and customer relationship management (CRM) systems

- A proactive and goal-oriented approach, with the ability to organise and manage your own work independently

- Readiness to work in an international and seasonal tourism environment

- Willingness to travel when required by the role


We particularly value previous experience in international tourism sales, cooperation with tour operators, hotel or resort sales, as well as an established network of contacts within the international travel trade. Additional language skills will be considered a significant advantage.

WHAT WE OFFER

- A unique opportunity to build the sales operations of an entirely new international tourism destination from the ground up

- A high-quality and genuinely distinctive Lapland travel product to represent and sell

- The opportunity to build North Resorts international customer and partner network

- An independent and responsible role where the results of your work have a direct and visible impact

- The opportunity to influence our sales practices, product development and international growth

- Close cooperation with the Resort Manager and the companys management

- Competitive compensation; applicants are welcome to state their salary expectations


Above all, we are looking for a sales professional who genuinely enjoys selling and identifying new customers. You will have the opportunity to play an important role in establishing North Resort as an internationally recognised travel destination and in building its customer base from the very first years of operation.

TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT

- The employment contract is permanent.

- The position is full-time.

- The employment relationship is governed by the Finnish Working Time Act and the applicable collective agreement.

- The role requires occasional flexibility in working hours and the ability to attend customer and sales meetings outside normal office hours when necessary.

- A six-month probationary period will apply in accordance with the Finnish Employment Contracts Act and the applicable collective agreement.

- Salary will be determined based on the responsibilities of the position and the successful candidates qualifications and experience. The position offers a competitive fixed salary plus the opportunity to earn a performance-based sales incentive. Applicants are welcome to state their salary expectations.

- Before commencing employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide an acceptable medical certificate confirming their fitness for the position.

jobs.title: Radiographers for long term opportunities in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

We are currently recruiting radiographers for a well-functioning radiology department in central Sweden.

The positions are available due to increased patient demand and upcoming retirements.

This is a long-term opportunity within a stable public healthcare provider offering modern equipment, a structured introduction programme, and a clear pathway toward Swedish professional authorization.

The department

The department consists of approximately 30 employees, including 15 radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and medical physicists. The unit operates in recently renovated facilities with newly upgraded CT, conventional X-ray, ultrasound and fluoroscopy equipment. An MRI replacement is planned.

Both acute and elective imaging are performed. The department collaborates closely with primary care, inpatient services, the emergency department, private healthcare providers, and other radiology units within the county. This ensures a varied and clinically broad workload.

Several radiographers have previously been internationally recruited and are now well established locally with their families, contributing to a supportive and inclusive working environment.

The hospital serves approximately 27,000 inhabitants locally and around 39,000 in the wider catchment area. The area offers a safe, family-friendly environment with access to schools, childcare, and extensive natural surroundings.

The role

The position includes standard duties as a licensed radiographer, primarily within:

    Conventional radiography
    CT
    MRI (may become part of responsibilities over time)

You will work with both emergency and planned examinations.

A structured introduction programme lasting 6–12 months is provided, depending on previous experience, to ensure competence in equipment, routines, and Swedish clinical standards.

Collaboration with a nearby radiology unit (approximately 40 minutes by car) may occur. Travel takes place during working hours.

Evening standby duty is included. Approximately once per week. You are required to be on site within 30 minutes when on standby duty. Therefore, it is necessary that you either hold a valid driver’s license and have access to a car, or live within close distance of the hospital.

Requirements

    Qualification in Radiography from an EU country
    The profession must be regulated in the country of qualification
    Currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
    Full legal right to practise independently as a radiographer
    Ability to work with CT and conventional radiography in acute and elective settings
    Good communication skills in English
    Willingness to learn Swedish – full support provided
    Qualification must be eligible for recognition by the Swedish National Board of
    Health and Welfare – we guide you through this application.
    Valid professional registration/license in the country of qualification
    Driving license/ B

Language and relocation

Swedish language training starts in your home country through individual online lessons with a private teacher. You study several hours per week alongside your current work.

Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.

After moving to Sweden, you begin working at 50% in a radiography assistant role while continuing your Swedish studies from B2 to C1. Work and language training are combined during this period, and the language education is provided and financed.

You begin working fully as a radiographer once Swedish authorization has been obtained.

Salary

    During the language completion phase (50% employment as Radiography Assistant): 30,800 SEK/month gross.

Estimated net salary is approximately 24,300 SEK/month, depending on individual tax rate.

    After obtaining Swedish authorization as a Radiographer: minimum 31,100 SEK/month gross.

Estimated net salary is approximately 24,500 SEK/month.

The salary after authorization is individually set and may be higher depending on experience, skills, and previous professional background.

The figures above refer to base salary. Additional compensation for standby duty, evening work, and shift-related supplements is not included in the stated amounts.

Application

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the final application date.

Submit your application today and include:

    CV / résumé
    Diploma and educational certificates/ Proof of professional license/registration
    Motivation letter
    References from at least one manager and one professional colleague

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Your role and responsibilities:
We are now looking for a (Senior) Project Engineer to join our team at Digital Systems, ELDS in Vaasa. In this position you will design, implement and commission automation and communication systems for the electrification of industrial plants, data centers, wind/solar plants and utility substations. You will succeed in this role if you are innovative, organized, and have the ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Due to the nature of the work and location of the development lab, majority of the work is Vaasa based.

You will be mainly accountable for: 
 Planning of the control system for the customer electrification networks 
 The implementation of the automation systems in the customer projects 
 Configuration of the Zenon based SCADA control system (ZEE600)

jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Combine meaningful work with a high quality of life

Is it time for a change?

Are you looking for a better worklife balance, shorter commuting times, and close access to nature without compromising on professional challenge and development? This opportunity may be the next step in your career.

We are a recruitment company supporting a well-established healthcare provider in Sweden in their search for a radiologists. The position is based in a scenic and nature-rich region, offering a safe and calm living environment with excellent opportunities for outdoor activities year-round, while still providing access to culture, services, and activities for the whole family.

About the role

As a specialist in radiology, you will be a key member of a well-functioning multidisciplinary team, working in close collaboration with referring clinicians and other healthcare professionals. The workplace is characterized by a positive working climate, strong collaboration, and a shared commitment to high-quality, patient-centered diagnostics.

Radiology services in Sweden are continuously evolving, with an increasing focus on:

    high-quality and timely diagnostic imaging
    advanced digital systems and efficient workflows
    close clinical collaboration and patient safety
    a sustainable and supportive work environment

The department provides a broad range of diagnostic imaging services, including assessment, interpretation, and reporting across multiple modalities, supporting patient care throughout all stages of life.

A varied and professionally rewarding position

The radiology department handles both scheduled examinations and acute imaging, offering a diverse and stimulating workload. You will have the opportunity to work broadly within radiology or further develop subspecialty interests, depending on your experience and the department’s needs.

The role is intellectually demanding and professionally rewarding, with strong opportunities for continuous learning, skills development, and long-term career growth.

What the workplace offers

In addition to a meaningful and stimulating role, the employer offers strong support for your professional development and well-being:

    Mentorship or professional guidance from an experienced radiologist
    Regular opportunities for professional development and continuing medical education
    A work environment that promotes good health, including a wellness allowance

We are looking for you who

    Are a certified specialist in radiology
    Value collaboration and enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams
    Are committed to delivering high-quality diagnostic services
    Are interested in combining a professionally fulfilling role with a high quality of life

What Dignus Medical Offers You:

    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
    Assistance with Swedish authorization and specialist recognition, if required
    Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for accompanying family members
    Access to a free Swedish language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Qualifications:

    EU-recognized specialist certification in radiology
    Good communication skills in English
    Willingness to learn Swedish

Interested in new opportunities?

Contact us to discuss available positions and find a role that fits your professional profile.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

You'll be part of a team that is passionate about helping ambitious businesses scale globally. We're collaborative, innovative, and deeply embedded in the UK startup ecosystem. Our team values learning, growth, and making a real impact - both for our customers and for each other. This is a place where you'll be empowered to take ownership, build relationships, and help shape the future of fintech in the UK.

What you'll do

As an Account Executive, Startups, you'll play a pivotal role in making Airwallex the finance stack of choice for the next generation of UK startups. You'll work closely with our VC and Community partnerships team to engage Seed-Series A startups, proactively source and outbound high-potential businesses, and ensure a seamless onboarding experience. You'll educate founders on our full product suite, enabling them to build their billing engine from scratch on the Airwallex platform. You'll also embed Airwallex in the startup community by attending events, hosting roundtables, and building our brand across the ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for early-stage startups, from prospecting and qualification to close and onboarding

  • Work closely with the VC Partnerships team to access and engage the next wave of high-growth startups, mapping out the startup ecosysetem strategically including accelerators, incubators, founder communities, angel investment communities, PortCos of key venture funds

  • Proactively source and outbound to Seed/Series A businesses to supplement top-down partnership efforts, identifying key PortCos from our partner funds that we could work with and support

  • Ensure a seamless, founder-friendly onboarding experience, guiding startups through KYC, product setup, and first transactions

  • Educate customers on the benefits of Airwallex's full product suite, helping them build scalable finance operations from day one. Offer monthly office hours for Airwallex for startup companies to book time in to learn more about the product. Identify where we are winning and areas of development. Be data led by collating feedback on which of our competitors are winning within the startup ecosystem and why

  • Actively embed Airwallex in the UK startup community: attend and speak at events, build relationships with founders and ecosystem partners, as well as contributing to startup content e.g. newsletter new product releases, key Airwallex startup news, VC spotlights

  • Be a visible advocate for Airwallex, sharing insights and success stories to build our brand and credibility in the startup ecosystem

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing and customer success to ensure startups get maximum value from Airwallex

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of sales experience in a B2B SaaS, Fintech or payments environment, in a sales development, account executive or account management role

  • Track record of meeting or exceeding targets

  • Demonstrated ability across the sales cycle - from self-sourced prospecting to close and onboarding

  • Genuine affinity and/or experience in the startup ecosystem. Familiarity with the UK startup landscape - key VCs, accelerators, incubators, investor/angel communities

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills - you're articulate, professional and equally comfortable presenting to a room of founders as you are doing a 1:1 deep dive with a Finance Lead over coffee

  • Capable of leading fast, frictionless deals via credible, strategic, visionary conversations with senior founders

  • Confident working in an event-driven activation model - attending and speaking at various events, conferences, dinners

  • Proficient in CRM and outreach tooling, and structured pipeline management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in fintech, payments, or financial services with an understanding of products such as global accounts, payment acceptance, FX, card issuing, or spend management.

  • Hands-on exposure to AI tools and agentic workflows (e.g. Claude, Cursor, or similar), or a track record of being an early adopter who can make new technology tangible for non-technical audiences.

  • Experience managing a backbook or portfolio of accounts alongside new business responsibilities, with demonstrated ability to retain and grow existing customers.

  • A visible personal presence in the startup community — whether through event attendance, LinkedIn activity, community involvement, or existing relationships with founders and investors.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset — prior founder experience or side-project background is a genuine plus, as it deepens your empathy for the customers we serve.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Technical Artist
jobs.description:
SpAItial is pioneering Physically-grounded World Models, a new AI paradigm designed to generate and reason about the appearance and physics of real and imagined environments. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the geometry of our world, and redefining how industries from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema create and interact with 3D environments.

We are looking for our first Technical Artist to create attention around SpAItial. Our models produce results worth staring at, and we need someone who can make that undeniable in public: short-form video, stills, and interactive demos that people stop for, published on X, LinkedIn, and YouTube at a steady cadence. You will take raw model outputs and make them look spectacular through camera, lighting, motion, VFX, and grade, and build 3D prototypes in Three.js, including AR and XR, that people can actually step into. A technical artist and prototyper, with a public social presence built on your own films, stills, and demos.

You sit next to our product engineers. You own the social presence that puts SpAItial in front of an audience, the artefacts that prove the models, and the prototypes that make the work felt.

We care far more about what you have made than where you have worked. Send us the account and the reel: films, stills, and demos that people remember, and an audience that comes back for the next one.

Responsibilities

  • Attention. Own how SpAItial shows up on X, LinkedIn, and YouTube: the cadence, the craft of each post, and the audience it builds. Turn our models and prototypes into work people stop for and share.

  • Video. Direct, shoot, and cut our films, from short-form pieces made for social to launch films and showreels.

  • Prototypes. Build interactive 3D prototypes in Three.js, including Gaussian splat scenes and AR and XR on headsets and phones, and take an idea to something clickable in days. Unreal is welcome for heavier real-time work.

  • Creative community. Engage designers, architects, technical artists, and spatial computing practitioners, and help run creative partner programs, workshops, and jams.

  • Technical art. Craft beautiful artefacts from our models, designing camera paths, lighting, and composition so a reconstruction reads as a finished piece rather than a research dump.

  • Finishing. Composite, grade, and add VFX, and deliver the stills and sequences that make a result obvious in five seconds.

Key qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in technical art, VFX, real-time 3D, creative technology, or a similar role.

  • A track record of building an audience. You have grown a following by publishing your own films, stills, or demos, and you can shoot, cut, and post short-form video at a weekly cadence without a studio behind you.

  • A portfolio of things you made yourself, publicly visible. We will spend more time on your films, stills, and prototypes than on your CV.

  • Technical-artist craft on 3D content. You can take a scene or a splat and turn it into a finished artefact through camera, lighting, composition, and look development.

  • VFX know-how, including compositing, motion graphics, grading, and shot finishing in tools such as After Effects, Nuke, Fusion, Blender, or Houdini.

  • Able to prototype in Three.js well enough to ship an interactive 3D demo without a hand-off. Experience in Unreal is a strong plus.

  • High ownership and comfortable with ambiguity. You will be the first person in this role and you will define it.

Nice to have

  • An audience that already overlaps ours, in 3D, spatial computing, VFX, or creative technology.

  • Hands-on AR, XR, or headset work: WebXR, native mobile AR, or spatial computing on Vision Pro or Quest.

  • Familiarity with Gaussian splats, photogrammetry, or other captured 3D representations.

  • A background in design, architecture, industrial design, animation, or VFX, or another discipline that trains you to think spatially and in shots.

  • Strong visual design across typography, layout, colour, and motion, applied to web, decks, and launch materials.

  • Experience contributing to a brand identity, including type and motion systems.

  • Experience running community programs, hackathons, or creator partnerships.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Company description:

Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.

Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent.

We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.

Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves  

The Head Unit Platform display teams in ConX are connecting Android to the hardware, i.e. develop device drivers, start-up/shut-down procedures, diagnostics/swdl, safety monitoring etc. They optimize and commonize code to be able to deliver the VCC sustainable platform to multiple new displays with speed.

     What you'll do  

Develop and integrate low-level software modules for current and upcoming Infotainment head units running the latest Android Automotive OS. We collaborate closely with our external suppliers and partners to achieve the goals.







Quality is assured by automated unit and integration tests as well as testing and troubleshooting in our prototype cars in the garage.

     What you'll bring  

You are a true developer who is motivated by challenging tasks, have a personal interest in technology and love to make the best software product out there. You enjoy learning from others, as well as sharing your knowledge with your colleagues. You like to see the whole picture and have an overall understanding of the complete system.







You are fluent in embedded C++ development and debugging with proven experience in developing software in Android Platform and an embedded Linux or QNX environment, preferably within automotive. Proven experience in QNX and/or device drivers is considered a plus.







You are a collaborative and responsible team player who considers what is best for the wider company and product. You have the confidence to speak up and trust your own expertise while remaining humble and open to the perspectives of others. You approach your work with an innovative but realistic mindset.







To succeed in the role, you communicate proactively to ensure progress, provide transparent status updates and can clearly explain software-design decisions. You are receptive to technical feedback and are comfortable reviewing colleagues’ code and providing constructive input.







You have experience from the automotive industry and are familiar with unit, component and manual testing, as well as test automation. You have worked in agile teams and are comfortable collaborating with stakeholders and external suppliers. You also have experience in software architecture and hardware-related development.








    QNX/Linux
    Drivers
    Serial communication
    Hardware specifications
    Object-oriented development
    C++
    Python
    Displays

jobs.title: Sejlmager, Autosadelmager, kalechesmed eller bare snild med hænderne.
jobs.description:
Sejlmager, Sadelmager eller bare snild med hænderne.

Velkommen til Schultz Sejlmageri ApS

Vi søger en ny kollega til vores systue/sejlloft i Kolding – en dygtig håndværker med flair for syning og sans for kvalitet. Har du erfaring med kalecher, sejl, telte eller autosadelmageri? Eller måske bare hænderne skruet rigtigt på og lyst til at arbejde i en niche, hvor ingen dage er ens? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

Du bliver en vigtig del af vores produktion, hvor vi udvikler, opmåler og syr kalecher, sprayhoods og sejl til både samt diverse industrielle afdækninger. Du kommer også til at bidrage til den generelle udvikling af virksomheden og vores produkter. Er du uddannet sejlmager så vil du komme til at stå for vores sejlloft som indebærer kunderådgivning, reparationer af sejl, opmåling og montering samt bestilling af nye sejl hos det anerkendte mærke Hyde Sails.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Opmåling, tilpasning og syning af kalecher, sprayhoods og sejl

  • Arbejde med forskellige materialer og specialopgaver

  • Kvalitetskontrol og løbende forbedringer i processer og produkter

  • Samarbejde med kolleger i en travl og alsidig hverdag

Hvem er du?

Du behøver ikke være uddannet sejlmager – men du skal have erfaring med håndværksfag, hvor præcision og kvalitet er i fokus. Måske har du arbejdet med autosadelmageri, telte, møbelpolstring eller noget helt fjerde?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er dygtig til håndværk og har erfaring med syning

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Bevarer overblikket i travle perioder

  • Er løsningsorienteret og kvalitetsbevidst

  • Trives i en mindre virksomhed med stor frihed

Hvem er vi?

Schultz Sejlmageri er en mindre virksomhed fra 1897 med ca. 8 medarbejdere. det startede som en læderforretning med seletøj, som senere blev til autopolstring og fra 70erne var det primært bådbranchen der blev produceret til. vi levere til både private og erhverv, i både ind- og udland.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Gode fysiske rammer og flextid

  • En hverdag med frihed under ansvar

  • Mulighed for at præge din egen rolle

  • Et uhøjtideligt miljø med passion for faget

  • løn efter kvalifikationer

Klar til at komme med ombord?

Send din ansøgning og evt. CV til info@schultz-sejl.dk – eller kig forbi os på Hesselly 8, 6000 Kolding. mærk ansøgningen med Sejlmager.

Har du spørgsmål? Ring til Nicolai Schultz på 76 32 12 00.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette.

Skal vi sy noget stort sammen?✂️

jobs.title: Consultant Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Consultant Acquisition Specialist for a global company in Stockholm. Start is ASAP, 6 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 75% onsite in Stockholm.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage the end-to-end consultant engagement lifecycle for assigned Staff Augmentation Consultant demand, ensuring accurate administration, traceability, and compliant handling in relevant systems.

Review and validate intake submissions, clarify scope and requirements, and challenge unclear demand to support sound sourcing and engagement decisions.

Lead competitive sourcing through the preferred supplier network by default and manage exceptions through documented rationale and escalation where needed.

Select and brief suppliers, assess submissions, build shortlists, and provide structured feedback to improve quality, relevance, and speed over time.

Support consultant selection and fee alignment, while final candidate choice remains with the hiring manager, and contribute to cost discipline through rate guidance and benchmarking where applicable.

Manage extensions, early terminations, offboarding, and compliance-related escalations, and partner with Procurement and adjacent teams to reinforce the preferred supplier model and support continuous improvement.

﻿

REQUIREMENTS

Experience and background: Relevant experience in consultant acquisition, contingent workforce coordination, procurement-supported hiring, or a similar role involving supplier interaction, stakeholder management, and end-to-end process coordination in a complex environment.

Education or certification: Relevant academic background or equivalent professional experience in HR, business, procurement, operations, or a related field.

Skills and competencies: Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to clarify demand, challenge unclear requirements, and support sound decisions without formal authority. Strong commercial awareness, structured judgement, attention to detail, and the ability to balance cost, quality, speed, and compliance are important.

Tools, systems, or methods: Experience working in an evolving environment with shifting priorities, and strong familiarity with Vendor Management Systems (VMS), KPI follow-up, and reporting to support decision-making and continuous improvement.

Other expectations: Able to work effectively across different business functions and hiring stakeholders while maintaining delivery quality and supporting continuous improvement.

﻿ This role requires fluency in English and Swedish.

This is a full-time consultant position in Stockholm through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 6 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 75% onsite in Stockholm.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description:
L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements et plus d'1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement, réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité. Chez Hello Watt nous électrifions également les logements en installant des panneaux solaires ou des pompes à chaleur partout en France.
Nous recherchons un Frontend Engineer, aussi à l'aise dans une application React web/TypeScript que dans une page server-rendered avec HTMX et AlpineJS, supporté par notre design system basé sur TailwindCSS.
Chez Hello Watt, le frontend est un pilier de l'expérience utilisateur : courbes de consommation, pilotage d'appareils en temps réel, parcours de souscription, design system partagé entre React et Django, tu seras au cœur de l'expérience de centaines de milliers de foyers, sur le web comme sur iOS et Android.
Nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeurs-euses. Nous cherchons à garder une qualité de code et une facilité de maintenance élevés, tout en embrassant les nouvelles pratiques et workflows IA.
Tes missions :
- Faire vivre et évoluer Firebolt, notre design system (Tailwind + composants React et Django) en facilitant l'intégration et l'adoption par les développeurs-euses full-stack.

- Veiller à des temps de chargements rapides pour tous sur l'app et le site hellowatt.fr (SEO, Core Web Vitals).

- Implémenter le frontend de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android).

- Définir les pratiques et les outils communs du frontend, faire converger l'existant : data-fetching, formulaires, state management, conventions de composants côté Django/htmx.

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Élargir la couverture et les outils de tests du frontend : tests de composants et de hooks (Vitest, Testing Library), scénarios end-to-end (Playwright), Storybook.

Profil recherché
Nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs-ices, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.
Compétences clés recherchées :
- Passion frontend : forte curiosité et veille active de son écosystème: supports des nouvelles fonctionnalités navigateurs, frameworks, tooling, patterns

- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques

- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée

- Architecture système : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

Compétences techniques recherchées :
- Expérience confirmée en développement frontend avec React et TypeScript, dans un environnement produit exigeant sur l'expérience utilisateur.

- À l'aise avec le rendu côté serveur et l'approche hypermedia: Templates Django, htmx, Alpine.js ou similaires.

- Habitué à travailler et/ou définir un design system.

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, composition, architecture modulaire par domaines métier.

- Apprécié : notions de Python/Django pour naviguer entre vues et templates, expérience du mobile hybride (capacitorjs).

- Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un poste similaire.

- Bac +5 université ou équivalent

Autres compétences recherchées :
- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

Environnement technique:
Frontend web app & native apps
- Language : TypeScript

- Framework: ReactJs

- Librairies: Tanstack Query, React Router, Lingui

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Radix ui, Storybook

- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)

Frontend Web
- Language : Django templating language & TypeScript

- Librairies: Htmx, Alpinejs

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Alpinejs, Storybook

Backend
- Language & Frameworks : Python avec Django (REST APIs, ORM, Admin)

- Bases de données : MySQL et MongoDB

Infrastructure & Déploiement
- Cloud Provider : AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, S3, RDS, etc.)

- CI/CD : GitLab CI pour l'intégration et le déploiement automatisés

Outils & Collaboration
- Gestion de projet : Linear (suivi des tâches, roadmap produit)

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

 - You will apply your expertise in statistical inference and experimentation to understand the impact of product changes and drive decision-making.

 - You will explore ambiguous areas and conduct analysis to identify opportunities for the Growth org, helping shape the strategy and roadmap.

 - You'll partner closely with product, engineering, and marketing leaders at every step of the development process, driving forward data science and analytics work.

 - You'll work with your teams to determine north star and operational metrics, and build the foundational datasets and dashboards to monitor progress and make key decisions.

 - You'll influence the broader company by communicating your findings and driving change in our product and business. (Insights are useful. Impact is even better!)
   
   


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - You are comfortable with ambiguity and motivated by business results.

 - You have expertise in SQL and at least one scripting language (ideally Python or R).

 - You know how to use statistical inference and experimentation to drive actionable recommendations.

 - You are comfortable transforming raw data to build your own data sets if the measure you need doesn't exist yet.

 - You have a bias for using the right tools to get a job done with maximum efficiency. You have experience making tradeoffs between speed and accuracy.

 - You have worked at a fast-growing start-up.

 - You have experience at a B2B SaaS company.

 - You have a track record of acting as a thought partner to product, engineering, and marketing leaders, driving strategic decisions on these teams using data.
