- Betreuung unserer Kunden bei Umrüstung und Modernisierung von Anlagen
- Führen von Angebots- und Auftragsverhandlungen
- Technische Ausarbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Anfragen
- Mitwirken an Messeveranstaltungen und Marketingmaßnahmen
- Erarbeitung von Marktanalysen und Ableitung von erforderlichen Maßnahmen

Ihr Profil

- Abschluss als Ingenieur, Wirtschaftsingenieur oder Techniker in der Fachrichtung Maschinenbau
- Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung mit technischen Produkten
- Kaufmännisches Denken
- Flexibilität, hohe Einsatzbereitschaft
- Selbstständige, zielorientierte, proaktive und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Hohe Reisebereitschaft
- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Gute Portugiesisch- und Spanischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

Wir bieten Ihnen

- Eine intensive Einarbeitung in ein breites, interessantes und vielseitiges Aufgabenfeld
- Die Mitarbeit in einem internationalen, mittelständischen Familienunternehmen
- Eine verantwortungsvolle Position bei einem etablierten Marktführer für Ketten und Kettenräder
- Einen hohen Grad an Eigenverantwortung der Raum lässt zur selbstbestimmten zielgerichteten Organisation der Tätigkeit
- Solide langfristige Perspektiven
- Eine leistungsgerechte Vergütung
- Zahlreiche soziale Leistungen

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, Benelux
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.

 

This role is based in Dublin, Ireland. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in Dutch

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets
   
   
   
    

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €70,000 OTE per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology & Digital Strategy
jobs.description:
About ShatterproofShatterproof is a national nonprofit working toward a world where addiction never defines or ends a life. Through evidence-based programs, advocacy, and public education, Shatterproof works to transform systems for tomorrow, support families today, and end stigma forever. Learn more at shatterproof.org.

Who Succeeds at Shatterproof
Shatterproof is in a period of transformative and rapid growth. We are building new systems, reimagining how work gets done, and creating more cross-functional alignment to accelerate our mission.
To thrive here, you should be energized by building, not just maintaining, and excited to bring structure, clarity, and innovation to evolving spaces.
We're looking for team members who:

  • Build systems and processes from the ground up and improve them continuously as we scale.
  • Take ownership and act with a builder's mindset, bringing forward solutions rather than waiting for direction.
  • Influence and collaborate across teams, shaping work through strong communication and relationship-building.
  • Move quickly, learn fast, and adapt with resilience, especially in a high-growth, high-impact environment.
  • Are mission-driven and motivated to leave their mark on an organization working to reverse the addiction crisis.

The RoleReporting to the Chief Financial & Administrative Officer, the Vice President, Technology & Digital Strategy serves as Shatterproof's senior technology executive and leads the organization's technology, digital operations, cybersecurity, data, artificial intelligence, enterprise applications, digital platforms, and technology-enabled products.
This leader will create and execute a comprehensive technology vision that advances organizational strategy, enables operational excellence, strengthens security and resilience, improves the employee experience, supports fundraising and advocacy, and drives innovation across mission-focused platforms.
This role is ideal for a builder who wants the rare opportunity to shape not only an organization's technology strategy, but also how technology, data, AI, and digital platforms accelerate mission impact at scale.

The Team

The Vice President leads a multidisciplinary team spanning enterprise technology, digital operations, data, and product management. Current direct reports and functional oversight areas include IT Operations, Digital Operations, enterprise CRM and database capabilities, Treatment Atlas Product Management, and Treatment Atlas Data Management. The role is responsible for developing these capabilities into a cohesive, high-performing technology function that provides exceptional organizational support while advancing Shatterproof's digital, data, and platform strategy.

The team supports and manages a broad portfolio that includes enterprise technology and workplace operations, cybersecurity and privacy, Salesforce and enterprise applications, website and fundraising technology, business intelligence and reporting, artificial intelligence initiatives, and the current and future technology architecture supporting Treatment Atlas.

In addition to leading the internal team, the Vice President oversees a network of managed service providers, software vendors, implementation partners, and technology consultants, ensuring that internal and external resources are aligned to organizational priorities and positioned to scale with Shatterproof's evolving needs. This includes stewardship of strategic technology platforms and vendor relationships that support operations, fundraising, advocacy, data management, and mission delivery. Key ResponsibilitiesEnterprise Technology Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise technology strategy aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on technology investments, risks, innovation opportunities, and emerging trends.
  • Establish technology governance, architecture standards, prioritization practices, and a transparent enterprise roadmap.
  • Evaluate and guide major technology investments, platform strategies, sourcing decisions, and vendor partnerships.
  • Ensure technology decisions support mission impact, operational effectiveness, sustainability, and growth.

 

AI Strategy & Digital Innovation
  • Lead Shatterproof's enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
  • Establish governance frameworks, risk controls, and responsible-use standards for AI technologies.
  • Identify and prioritize AI use cases across fundraising, operations, impact programs, and administration.
  • Lead tool evaluation, pilots, implementation planning, adoption, training, and change management.
  • Monitor emerging technologies and assess opportunities to create measurable organizational value.

 

IT Operations & Workplace Technology
  • Lead IT and workplace technology operations for a distributed workforce.
  • Oversee managed service providers, help desk operations, devices, Microsoft 365, identity and access, collaboration tools, and general application administration.
  • Ensure timely and secure onboarding, offboarding, access management, and technology provisioning.
  • Maintain service standards, knowledge management, policies, procedures, and documentation.
  • Continuously improve reliability, support quality, and the employee technology experience.

 

Cybersecurity, Privacy & Organizational Resilience
  • Lead enterprise cybersecurity strategy, policies, governance, and training.
  • Oversee risk assessments, incident response, cyber insurance requirements, Keeper governance, backups, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
  • Partner with leaders to protect organizational, employee, donor, constituent, and program data.
  • Monitor emerging risks and drive practical, prioritized mitigation plans.

 

Digital Platforms, Website & Fundraising Technology
  • Lead the strategy, governance, performance, accessibility, analytics, and integrations for Shatterproof's website and digital engagement ecosystem.
  • Oversee fundraising and advocacy technologies, including DonorDrive and New Mode, and related digital vendors.
  • Partner with Development, Marketing & Communications, and Public Affairs to strengthen constituent experience, engagement, and platform value.
  • Oversee Google Analytics and related reporting and optimization capabilities.

 

Salesforce & Enterprise Applications
  • Own the enterprise Salesforce roadmap and governance framework.
  • Oversee administration, security, permissions, data quality, integrations, reporting, releases, user support, and adoption.
  • Partner with department leaders to prioritize enhancements, automation, workflow improvements, and reporting needs.
  • Ensure enterprise applications remain aligned with operational and strategic priorities.

 

Data, Analytics & Business Intelligence
  • Establish organization-wide data governance, reporting standards, and stewardship practices.
  • Oversee dashboards, data models, access, refreshes, data quality, and Power BI capabilities.
  • Partner with leaders to improve data-informed decision-making and performance visibility.
  • Build scalable, well-governed analytics and reporting capabilities.

 

Treatment Atlas Platform & Product Leadership
  • Serve as technology executive sponsor for Treatment Atlas in close partnership with Impact leadership.
  • Oversee current processing infrastructure, operational monitoring, troubleshooting, releases, integrations, data flows, and vendor coordination.
  • Lead the reimagined platform product and technical roadmap, delivery oversight, architecture, cloud strategy, security, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure platform reliability, scalability, security, usability, and long-term sustainability.

 

Technology Financial Management & Vendor Strategy
  • Develop and manage the annual technology budget, forecasts, and multi-year investment plans.
  • Oversee invoices, purchasing, contracts, renewals, licensing, and license optimization.
  • Lead major vendor decisions, negotiations, performance management, and strategic relationships.
  • Develop clear business cases and recommendations for significant technology investments.
  • Oversee the purpose, vendor relationship, users, integrations, renewals, support, and roadmap for Just5, and manage the LegitScript relationship, certifications, submissions, renewals, and organizational obligations.

 

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary technology and digital operations team.
  • Create clarity around roles, decision rights, service ownership, priorities, and cross-functional ways of working.
  • Assess future capability, capacity, structure, and sourcing needs.
  • Build a culture grounded in accountability, service, collaboration, innovation, documentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Communicate complex technology issues in accessible, business-oriented language and lead change with transparency.

 

Ideal Experience & Qualifications
  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience spanning technology, digital operations, enterprise systems, product management, data, cybersecurity, or related disciplines.
  • Experience serving as the senior technology leader for a complex organization and developing enterprise technology strategies and roadmaps.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building organizational capability.
  • Strong experience with cybersecurity, technology governance, privacy-supporting controls, risk management, and organizational resilience.
  • Experience leading CRM, data, analytics, digital platforms, enterprise applications, and major technology implementations.
  • Experience overseeing technology budgets, contracts, licensing, vendor relationships, and implementation partners.
  • Experience introducing and scaling AI-enabled solutions, governance, adoption, and training.
  • Ability to translate organizational needs into practical technology priorities, investments, and execution plans.
  • Executive presence and strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a mission-driven, distributed, and evolving environment.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience required; advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.
  • Deep alignment with Shatterproof's mission and values.

CompensationThe salary range for this position is $175,000 to $190,000. Placement within the range is determined by experience, internal equity, and organizational budget.

Additional Information
  • Ability and authorization to work in the United States required.
  • Ability to work Eastern Time Zone hours required.
  • Domestic travel may be required based on organizational needs.
  • Shatterproof is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

GulvKanonen ApS arbejder med gulvafslibning og efterbehandling af trægulve. Vi udfører mange forskellige gulvopgaver for privatekunder, og derfor sørger vi nu en ny gulvmand til vores team af dygtige medarbejdere.

Har du erfaring som gulvsliber og ønsker at arbejde i en tempofyldt virksomhed? Så er dette job lige noget for dig!

Om jobbet:

Hos GulvKanonen kommer du til at arbejder med afslibning, polering og efterbehandling af trægulve (normale efterbehandlinger , som lak, lud, olie og sæbe)

Du får stillet firmabil til rådighed og kommer typisk til at køre alene. Alle opgaver er hos private kunder og af forskellige karakter. Derfor kommer du heller ikke til at arbejde med de samme opgaver hver eneste dag.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har minimum 2 års erfaring inden for gulvafslibning

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, struktureret og effektivt

  • Arbejdstiden er i tidsrummet 07.00-15.00

  • Har kørekort B

  • Er serviceminded og pålidelig

  • Sætter en ære i flor og veludført arbejde

Vi tilbyder:

  • God fast løn

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • En god arbejdsplads

  • Firmabil til arbejdsbrug

  • Maskiner og værktøj til arbejdsopgaver

  • Arbejdstøj

Lyder stillingen som gulvsliber interessant, eller har du spørgsmål? Så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os på mail info@gulvkanonen.dk

Send din ansøgning og dit cv på mail og skriv "Gulvsliber" i emnefeltet. Samtaler afholdes løbende med ansættelse hurtigst muligt.

 

ENGLISH

GulvKanoen ApS works with floor sanding and finishing of wooden floors. We perform many different floor jobs for private customers, and we are now looking for a new floor sanding specialist for our team of skillede employees.

Do you have experience with floor sanding and would like to work in a busy company? Then this is the job for you!

About the job:

At GulvKanonen, you will be working with floor sanding and finishing of wooden floors (standard finishing, such as varnish, lye, oil, and soap).

A company car will be provided for you, and you will typically be driving on your own. Alle jobs take place at privat customers,, and the jobs vary much so you will not be experiencing the same jobs day after day.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least 2 years of experience with floor sanding

  • Can work independently, structured, and efficiently

  • Working hours are from 07.00-15.00

  • Have driving licence B

  • Are service-minded and dependable

  • Take pride in well-performed results

We offer:

  • A good, fixed salary

  • Freedom with reponsibility

  • A good workplace

  • Company car (work-related driving)

  • Machines and tools for all tasks

  • Work clothes

Send you application and your resume via mail and write "Floor sanding specialist" in the subject line. Interviews are conducted regularly with hiring as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Content Onboarding
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Content Onboarding team builds the systems that help customers move content into Notion, get started faster, and keep growing reliably over time. The role matters because one of Notion’s core differentiators is replacing multiple tools — and that only becomes real when customers can get their information out of those tools and into Notion with confidence. You’ll partner with product and engineering leaders to shape the future of our content importers, internal administrative tooling, and compliance workflows like exports.

This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Shape the technical and product vision for Notion’s import systems, so customers can pull content from more sources and transform it into a trustworthy system of record.

 - By your 90th day, you’ll have clarified the near-term roadmap and de-risked the most important technical decisions for importers, exports, and internal admin tooling. You’ll connect AI-era and agentic workflow patterns to onboarding and import experiences — using AI to improve product judgment, prototyping, and engineering quality from design through production.

 - By the end of your first year, engineering excellence will be a team norm: reliable systems, clear operational standards, and a shared understanding of what it takes to keep critical workflows running. You will have a steady operating rhythm with HQ while owning a clear north star for the Content Onboarding surface area.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong technical leadership: you can represent the team’s work, hold a high engineering bar, and de-risk decisions through clear processes, delegation, and senior IC partnership.

 - Ability to craft and maintain multi-quarter team strategy, especially where outcomes depend on adjacent product and engineering teams.

 - Experience developing senior engineers, strengthening operating rhythms, and building high-performing engineering teams with durable standards.

 - Distributed-team leadership: you can set direction for a local team while staying tightly coordinated with cross-functional partners across time zones.
   
   

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.



You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 4+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco and New York, the estimated OTE (On-Target Earnings) range is $145,000-$175,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.title: Executive Operations Partner - EPD (Executive Assistant)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Our Executive Operations team work closely with Notion’s leadership, serving as trusted advisors, collaborators, and problem-solvers. We focus on amplifying the impact of our executives by anticipating needs, streamlining operations, and building systems that keep leaders focused on the highest leverage work. We’re deeply connected to Notion’s mission and values, and we take pride in creating an environment of collaboration, clarity, and authenticity. Our team thrives on strong relationships, operational excellence, and a shared commitment to building tools that empower people to think and work together more effectively.

This role calls for someone who is proactive, adaptable, and deeply organized. Someone who can balance complex scheduling, drive cross-functional coordination, and bring clarity to fast moving priorities. This person will support 2 leaders in our Engineering and Product orgs. Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, operates independently, and consistently finds ways to improve workflows and communication. You’ll be a key partner in making sure our leaders and the company as a whole can move quickly while staying aligned. 

 

This role is based in our New York office.We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Organizational support: Partner with Engineering and Product leaders on running the day-to-day of an efficient, high-velocity, and fun organization

 - Calendar management: Prioritize and coordinate the teams’ operating calendar, ensuring time is spent in a way that's most leveraged to achieve our business objectives

 - Meeting aficionado: Organize, attend, and track meeting notes and action items, with an eye on making every interaction productive and warm

 - Travel planner: Flights, hotels, transportation, dining, etc. A strong attention to detail here is valued

 - Expense management: Manages expense reports for the executives you support

 - Culture carrier and community builder: Craft fun & engaging team offsite experiences, celebrate birthdays and anniversaries, new family members, and promotions to ensure employees continue to feel connected and recognized




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of Executive Operations experience at fast-growing companies, ideally with experience with technical teams.

 - Organized and detail-oriented: Strong attention to detail, able to stay calm under pressure, a quick thinker, create order of out chaos

 - Effective communicator: Ability to communicate the priorities of leadership within Notion, whether it is by written, verbal, or group communication

 - Event planning: Experience organizing team events with hundreds of people, as well as multi-day events with smaller groups of people, such as an executive offsite

 - EQ: Love connecting with employees, and have proven ability to build relationships and bring warmth to all levels of the organization

 - Discreet: Demonstrated ability to maintain complete confidentiality on all business matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're a Notion evangelist! You love the product, and already use it in your daily life



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $65.38 – $76.92/hr.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, pisanu provjeru stručnih sposobnosti koje su potrebne za obavljanje poslova ovog radnog mjesta i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 19. kolovoza 2026. godine. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull'educazione e l’istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23), e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 10 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il seguente posto di lavoro di 1 OPERATORE TECNICO / OPERATRICE TECNICA addetto/a alla manutenzione per lo svolgimento delle mansioni di bidello e fuochista - addetto/a al riscaldamento centrale, a tempo determinato e orario completo (supplenza) CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: Oltre alle condizioni generali in conformità alle norme generali sul lavoro, i candidati devono soddisfare anche le condizioni previste dall'articolo 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU n. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) e secondo il Regolamento sull'ambito di lavoro del segretario e sulle mansioni tecnico-amministrative svolte nella scuola elementare (GU n. 40 /14, 71/25, 74/25-correzione):
  1. Scuola media superiore di ramo tecnico
  2. Esame per fuochisti – addetti al riscaldamento centrale
  3. Idoneità sanitaria per lo svolgimento di mansioni a rischio specifico
  4. assenza di condanne penali per i reati indicati nell'articolo 106 della Legge sull'educazione el'istruzione elementare e media superiore.
NOTA: La prova della specifica idoneità sanitaria del/la candidato/a per il posto di lavoro si ottiene prima della stipula del contratto di lavoro, conformemente alle disposizioni dell’articolo 24, commi 2 e 3, della Legge sul lavoro (GU 93/14, 127/17, 98/19, 151/22, 46/23, 64/23). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • i dati biografici (Curriculum vitae),
  • la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova attestante il superamento dell'esame per fuochista – addetto al riscaldamento centrale,

La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, la verifica scritta delle competenze professionali necessarie per lo svolgimento delle mansioni relative a questo posto di lavoro ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 19 agosto 2026.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent), in Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

Nice to have

Bonus Points

- Experience

jobs.title: IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator 100% (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator 100% (m/w/d)

vor Ort Roggwil TG, Thurgau, Schweiz

• Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze

• Transparente Kommunikation sowie eine familiäre Unternehmenskultur

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen und Rabatte

Jobbeschreibung

Die kybun Joya Retail AG in Roggwil gehört zur kybun Joya Gruppe, welche Komfortschuhe und weitere Gesundheitslösungen in der Schweiz entwickelt, produziert und in mehr als 40 Ländern vertreibt. Ziel ist es, den Menschen durch kompetente Beratung schmerzfreie Bewegung zu ermöglichen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Roggwil suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine teamfähige, flexible und belastbare Persönlichkeit.

Als IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator sind Sie das technische Rückgrat unserer digitalen Infrastruktur und gleichzeitig Motor unserer KI-Transformation. Sie sorgen für eine stabile, sichere Netzwerk- und Systemlandschaft und treiben aktiv die Integration von KI-Lösungen in unsere Geschäftsprozesse voran. Die Rolle ist eng verzahnt mit dem E-Commerce-, Support- und Marketing-Team.

Ihre Aufgaben

Netzwerk & IT-Infrastruktur

- Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung der Netzwerkinfrastruktur an unseren Standorten Roggwil, Sennwald und unseren eigenen Shops in Europa (LAN/WLAN, Firewalls, VPN, Switching, Routing)
- Betrieb und Pflege der Server-, Client- und Cloud-Umgebung (Microsoft 365, Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams Telefonie)
- Verwaltung von Endgeräten inkl. Device Enrollment, Intune-Policies und Lizenzmanagement
- Konfiguration und Pflege von Domains, DNS-, SPF- und Zertifikatsstrukturen (z. B. sichere LDAP-Zertifikate, Mail-Deliverability)
- Hardware-Beschaffung & -Verwaltung (Client/Server)
- Gelegentlicher Vor-Ort-Support für Shops, inkl. Reisetätigkeit bei Neueinrichtungen

IT-Sicherheit & Compliance

- Sicherstellung der IT-Sicherheit durch Patch-Management, Zero-Trust-Ansätze, MFA und Endpoint Protection
- Incident Response bei Sicherheitsvorfällen (z. B. Phishing, kompromittierte Accounts) inkl. interner Kommunikation
- Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender in Sicherheitstools wie Bitwarden (Passwortmanagement)
- Unterstützung bei ISO 9001 Audits und Umsetzung von Compliance-Vorgaben

Monitoring, Support & Systempflege

- Monitoring, Troubleshooting und 2nd-Level-Support für Netzwerk, Systeme und User Requests
- Bearbeitung und Priorisierung von IT-Tickets und Weiterentwicklung des Ticket-Prozesses
- Planung und Durchführung von Systemupdates, Rollouts und Migrationen mit minimaler Downtime
- Dokumentation von Prozessen, Konfigurationen und Wissensdatenbank-Artikeln

KI-Integration & Automatisierung

- Integration von KI in bestehende Prozesse und Systeme in enger Zusammenarbeit mit E-Commerce, Kundenservice und Marketing
- Design, Erstellung und Optimierung von Prompts für generative KI-Modelle (z. B. für Übersetzungen, Kundenservice, Content-Erstellung)
- Konzeption und Umsetzung von Workflows in n8n und Anbindung an Systeme wie Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Synthflow und weitere APIs
- Betrieb und Optimierung von KI-Agenten (z. B. Gorgias AI Agent, Synthflow Telefonie, Copilot-Anwendungen)
- Qualitätssicherung und Monitoring KI-generierter Inhalte – inkl. Fehlerdiagnose, Fallback-Logik und Reporting
- Evaluation neuer KI-Tools und Modelle sowie Ableitung von Business-Use-Cases
- Schulung und Enablement interner Teams im Umgang mit KI-Tools (z. B. Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gorgias AI)

Stellenanforderungen

Ausbildung & Erfahrung

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Informatik, Systemtechnik, Netzwerktechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Mind. 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT-Administration, idealerweise in einem KMU- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld
- Erste praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-Tools, Prompt Engineering und/oder Automatisierungsplattformen (n8n, Zapier, Make o. ä.)

Fachliche Kompetenzen

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik (TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, Firewalls, WLAN-Controller)
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Microsoft-365-Welt: Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint
- Erfahrung mit PowerShell-Skripting oder anderen Automatisierungssprachen
- Verständnis für IT-Security-Prinzipien (MFA, Zero Trust, Endpoint Protection, Backup-Strategien)
- Grundverständnis für APIs, Webhooks und JSON zur Integration von Systemen
- Erfahrung mit oder starkes Interesse an Generativer KI, LLMs, RAG-Konzepten und Prompt-Optimierung
- Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Adyen oder vergleichbaren SaaS-Plattformen

Persönliche Stärken

- Analytisches Denken und strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Zuverlässigkeit
- Neugier und Innovationsfreude, insbesondere im Bereich KI und Digitalisierung
- Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten – Sie können komplexe Themen verständlich erklären
- Teamplayer mit Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen zwischen den Standorten Roggwil und Konstanz

Sprachen

- Deutsch verhandlungssicher (C2)
- Englisch gute Kenntnisse (B2) für Dokumentation und internationale Tools/Partner

jobs.title: Boltvezető-helyettes HUMANIC - Duna Plaza üzletbe (Verkaufsfahrer/in)
jobs.description:
RÓLUNK

A LEDER & SCHUH AG két értékesítési márkájával, a HUMANIC-kal és a SHOE4YOU-val Európa egyik legnagyobb cipőkereskedője. A vállalat kilenc országban (AT, DE, CZ, SK, HU, HU, SI, HR, RO, BG) mintegy 200 telephelyen mintegy 2000 embert foglalkoztat. A vállalat központja a stájer fővárosban, Grazban található. Nagy hangsúlyt fektetünk a hosszú távú munkakapcsolatok kiépítésére és a vállalaton belüli karrierépítésre.

A HUMANIC kilenc országban mintegy 140 üzletből álló hálózattal rendelkezik, amelyek közül tizennyolc üzlet Magyarországon található, az európai cipőipar úttörőjeként. Akár az elegáns és vonzó üzletek egyikében, akár az online shopban - a HUMANIC-nál a cipők iránti szenvedélyt megéljük. És ez már 1872 óta így van.

A SHOE4YOU a jó minőséget és a kedvező árat képviseli. A SHOE4YOU divatos női-, férfi- és gyermekcipő kínálatával a cipőpiac megkerülhetetlen szereplőjévé vált Ausztria-szerte, mintegy 70 üzletével és saját online áruházával.

AZ ÖN FELADATAI

- Boltvezető helyettesítése
- Ügyfélkiszolgálás és értékesítés.
- Üzleti célok elérésének biztosítása
- Üzletünk szabályainak betartatása
- Üzletünk rendjének és tisztaságának fenntartása.

jobs.title: Farmimehaanik
jobs.description:
Otsime oma meeskonda farmimehaanikut, kes aitaks hoida töös meie suure piimafarmi tehnika ja seadmed.

Tööülesanded: Oleme edukas ja arenev põllumajandusettevõte, kus väärtustame kaasaegseid lahendusi, tugevat meeskonda ja inimesi, kes tahavad oma tööga päriselt midagi ära teha.
Farmis on ligikaudu 1000 looma, mistõttu on tehniliste süsteemide sujuv toimimine meie igapäevatöös väga olulisel kohal. See on hea võimalus inimesele, kes soovib teha praktilist ja mitmekesist tööd ning olla osa ettevõttest, mis areneb, investeerib ja kasvab. Sinu tööks saab olema: - farmi masinate ja seadmete hooldus ning remont; - lüpsi- ja muude farmiseadmete rikete tuvastamine ning kõrvaldamine; - tehnosüsteemide korrasoleku jälgimine; - ennetavate hooldustööde tegemine; - erinevate tehniliste probleemide lahendamine; - koostöö farmi meeskonna ja teiste tehnikutega.

Omalt poolt pakume: - Olla osa professionaalsest ja toetavast meeskonnast;
- teha mitmekesist tööd kaasaegses piimafarmis; - arendada oma tehnilisi teadmisi ja oskusi; - töötada erinevate seadmete ja tehnosüsteemidega; - kaasa rääkida ja oma teadmistega ettevõtte arengusse panustada; - kindlat ja pikaajalist töökohta; - töötasu suurus sõltub oskustest ning panusest; - vajalikud töövahendid ja tööriided; - ametiauto.

Muud nõuded: Meie ootused:
Sul on hea tehniline taip ja praktiline mõtlemine; oskad või soovid õppida masinaid ja seadmeid remontima; oled iseseisev, kohusetundlik ja lahendustele orienteeritud; hindad vaheldusrikast tööd ja soovid oma töö tulemust päriselt näha. Varasem kogemus piimafarmis ei ole tingimata vajalik. Olulisem on huvi tehnika vastu, õppimisvõime ja soov areneda.

Sinu roll tugiisikuna: olla lapsele igapäevane toetaja ja julgustaja; aidata kaasa lapse arengule ja iseseisvuse kujunemisele; luua turvaline ja hooliv keskkond; teha koostööd pere ja spetsialistidega.

jobs.title: COSTING ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Role Summary

The Costing Engineer â Jigs & Fixtures is responsible for the end-to-end financial estimation of specialized tooling required for electronic assembly lines. This role involves analyzing technical drawings, calculating manufacturing costs for custom parts, and budgeting for complex automation components. The goal is to provide accurate "Should-Cost" models that ensure high-quality assembly solutions are delivered within budget.

Core Responsibilities

  • Component & Material Estimation
  • Fabricated Parts: Calculate costs for metallic (Al, SS) and non-metallic (ESD plastics, Delrin) parts by evaluating material weight, machining cycles (CNC/VMC), and finishing processes.
  • Bought-Out Items: Source and maintain price benchmarks for:
    • Mechanical: Bearings, linear rails, and precision slide ways.
    • Pneumatics: Cylinders, DCV valves, and manifold systems.
    • Automation: PLCs, sensors (proximity/optical), magnets, and HMI units.
    • Electrical: Push buttons, switches, wiring harnesses, and connectors.
  • Assembly & Validation Costing
  • Estimate man-hours for mechanical assembly, pneumatic plumbing, and electrical wiring.
  • Factor in costs for fixture testing, calibration, and $Cpk/Ppk$ validation runs.
  • Strategic Financial Analysis
  • Conduct Make vs. Buy analyses for custom fixture components.
  • Perform Value Engineering (VA/VE) to suggest lower-cost alternatives for non-critical parts without sacrificing precision or safety.
  • Maintain a live database of vendor quotes and historical cost data.
Technical Requirements

  • Education: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or Production Engineering.
  • Experience: 3â5 years in costing, specifically within high-precision tooling or electronics assembly.
  • Software Proficiency: * Advanced MS Excel (Macro/Pivot tables) and ERP systems (SAP/Oracle).
    • Ability to view and measure parts using CAD software (SolidWorks/AutoCAD).
  • Process Knowledge: Deep understanding of milling, turning, grinding, and surface treatments.
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

  • Estimation Accuracy: Variance between estimated cost and actual procurement cost.
  • Turnaround Time: Speed of providing quotes for new assembly line projects.
  • Cost Savings: Success in identifying 5-10 %$ annual savings through Value Engineering.

BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  • High attention to detail (zero-error mindset).
  • Strong negotiation skills for dealing with external vendors.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively between Design, Procurement, and Finance teams.

jobs.title: Senior Structural Lead – Naval Ship Construction; DK - Esbjerg, DK - Frederikshavn
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced structural or marine engineer who knows how to turn complex vessel or larger steel structure designs into safe, buildable solutions? This is a rare opportunity to take technical ownership of structural construction for modern naval vessels and help strengthen the future of the Danish naval industry.

Your position
Join Semco Maritime as Senior Structural Lead and take a central role in the construction of modern naval vessels for the Royal Danish Navy. Working at the interface between engineering, procurement, planning, suppliers, and shipyard production, you will translate structural designs and class requirements into practical construction strategies that support safe and efficient execution.

As the senior technical focal point for structural construction, you will influence key decisions from design maturity and production engineering through fabrication, assembly, and delivery. You will coordinate multidisciplinary interfaces, anticipate constructability and schedule risks, and help ensure that structural work is completed to the required quality, safety, and regulatory standards.

This is a visible, hands-on leadership role with close proximity to production and real influence on how the vessels are built. Your primary workplace will be in Frederikshavn or alternatively Esbjerg. The position is full-time, permanent, and occasional travel may be required.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As the Senior Structural Lead for structural construction, you will lead and coordinate the structural construction activities throughout the naval vessel production lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include:
  • Defining and planning the structural construction route from design to production.
  • Leading the production engineering process and providing technical support to procurement.
  • Serving as the technical point of contact for structural construction matters across departments and with suppliers.
  • Managing resources, supervising assembly, and ensuring adherence to quality, schedule, and HSE standards.
  • Supporting production planning to develop efficient and buildable solutions.

Your profile & qualifications
We are seeking a proactive and technically adept engineer who excels in a multidisciplinary environment and has a passion for shipbuilding and naval defence.

Ideal qualifications:
  • BSc or MSc in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Welding Engineering, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience in shipbuilding / ship construction. Alternative could be experience from large scale off-shore construction and / or infrastructure sites or process facilities. 
  • Familiarity with international classification rules (e.g., DNV, ABS); knowledge of naval or defence standards is highly beneficial.
  • Proficient in interpreting technical drawings and 3D models.
  • Fluency in English is required; Danish language skills are a significant advantage.
  • You should have a structured, quality-focused approach with excellent coordination and communication skills.
  • High personal integrity and a strong commitment to health, safety, and environmental standards.
  • Able to obtain a FE security clearance

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the planet. By joining us, you will become part of a community of over 2,300 dedicated thinkers and doers who drive meaningful change and leave their mark on the world. 

We provide the answers needed to make change real, believing that ambitious goals can only be achieved through hard work and innovative, pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a better future.

So yes, working for us will spark change – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.
Apply
Share in your network

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.
